# REDZ.UI - the documentation in full

# Getting started

REDZ.UI is a stylesheet, its icons and one small script on the browser platform. Nothing is built where it is used: link the three files, write Bootstrap-like markup, and the browser does the rest.

## Get it

Every release is an immutable release on GitHub: once it is out, neither its tag nor its files can change. `redz-ui-0.9.0.zip` holds the library's files and its passport, `redz-ui.json` - the version, the floor, the two files a project serves, the stylesheets and modules they are made of, every class, token, command and text key, and the sha256 of every file. `checks.zip` beside it is the sheet of the probes the release passed in every engine.

```js
gh release download v0.9.0 --repo redz-tech/REDZ.UI --pattern 'redz-ui-*.zip'
gh release verify-asset v0.9.0 redz-ui-0.9.0.zip --repo redz-tech/REDZ.UI
```

Or from jsDelivr, which serves a release by its tag:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/redz-tech/REDZ.UI@v0.9.0/dist/redz-ui.min.css">
```

## Include it

The stylesheet, the icons and the scripts, with the page's own words for the few things the library says - every word comes from the page, the library has none of its own.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/dist/redz-ui.min.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/css/icons.css">
  <script type="module" src="redz-ui/dist/redz-ui.min.js"></script>
  <script type="application/json" id="redz-ui-text">{"close": "Close", "confirm.ok": "OK", "confirm.cancel": "Cancel", "busy": "Loading…"}</script>
</head>
```

- `dist/redz-ui.min.css` is the layers, the tokens, the components and the utilities in one file, within its budget of 26 KB gzipped: the stylesheets `css/index.css` pulls in, squeezed.
- `css/icons.css` is apart: one mask per Bootstrap Icons file, used only by name. It reaches each file by a URL relative to itself, `../icons/NAME.svg`, so the release's folders keep their shape where a project serves them. A project that marks its static files by their content (`?h=…`) cannot mark the icons this way: it serves each release from a folder of its own version instead, which changes with every release.
- `dist/redz-ui.min.js` is one ES module of the behaviors, within its budget of 25 KB gzipped: the modules of `js/index.js` joined, squeezed and given short local names. It sets `REDZ.ui` for calls from code.
- The island `#redz-ui-text` gives the library its words, in the page's language: every key of the passport's `texts`, and for each key of its `plurals` the other forms its language's plural rules name (`found.one`, `found.few`). The example shows four of them.
- The two files are made from `css/` and `js/`, which stay to read. A project that bundles its own may join the stylesheets in the passport's order instead.

## How it reads

- A component, its variant, its size and its parts are one class each: `btn btn-primary btn-sm`, `card-header` - Bootstrap 5's names, and Bootstrap 6's where it moved onto the platform: `dialog`, `drawer`, `menu`.
- A utility is `property-value`: `d-flex`, `text-muted`. The number is the value - `p-16` is 16 px, `w-50` is 50 %.
- A condition is a prefix: `md:cols-2`, `print:d-none`. A width prefix measures the region the element sits in - a column, a card, a dialog - not the window.
- A state is an HTML attribute: `aria-pressed`, `aria-current`, `disabled`, `[open]`. A button opens a menu or a dialog with the browser's own command: `commandfor` + `command`.
- Tokens are `--redz-` plus the same words: `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-space-16`.

## Theme and direction

Without an attribute the page follows the system's light or dark. `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` fixes one - set it on the server, so the page never flashes. Right to left is `dir="rtl"`: one stylesheet serves both directions, by logical properties, and icons that point mirror with `flip-rtl`.

```html
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl" data-theme="dark">
```

## From script

Menus, tabs, dialogs and their keys need no call: the library listens on the document. Three calls are for code:

| Call | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `REDZ.ui.toast({title, text, tone, action, persistent})` | Shows a notice; answers a function that closes it. [Toasts](toast.md) |
| `await REDZ.ui.confirm({title, text, ok, cancel, tone})` | Asks a question in a dialog; answers `true` or `false`. [Dialogs](dialog.md) |
| `await REDZ.ui.busy(element, promise)` | Marks a button or a region busy until the promise settles. [Busy](busy.md) |

## Browsers

Bootstrap 6's floor: Chrome and Edge 130+, Firefox 132+, Safari 18+ on macOS and iOS. What must work rests on features of the floor; invoker commands and anchor positioning are written in their final form, and a small script stands in below them. Every page of these docs is checked in real engines at the floor and above - [the checks](https://redz-tech.github.io/REDZ.UI/checks/).

Below the floor a page shows its own words, not a broken screen. `js/floor.js`, a plain script first in the head, before the stylesheets, marks `<html data-floor="below">` when the browser lacks a feature the library is built on; the page's own style shows its "update your browser" then. Every product that loads it judges a browser the same way, and the floor gate holds that no browser at the floor fails it.

```html
<script src="redz-ui/js/floor.js"></script>
<style>.floor-notice { display: none; } [data-floor="below"] .floor-notice { display: block; }</style>
```

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-bs-theme` | `data-theme` | rename | light or dark on <html> |

# Layout

The parent sets the grid, the number is the count, and a width prefix measures the region the element is in. Stacks for a column or a row of items, gaps between them, no margins on components.

## Grids

`grid` on the parent, `cols-N` for N equal columns, `gap-*` between them. A width prefix adds columns as the region grows: `grid md:cols-2` is one column until the region is 768 px wide. Every example on these pages is a region of its own - resize the window and watch the examples, not the window.

```html
<div class="grid sm:cols-2 lg:cols-4 gap-16">
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">One</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">Two</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">Three</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">Four</div></div>
</div>
```

### Spans on a 12-column grid

A child's exception: `span-N` or `span-full`, with a prefix where it changes.

```html
<div class="grid md:cols-12 gap-16">
	<div class="card md:span-8"><div class="card-body">The main column - <code>md:span-8</code></div></div>
	<div class="card md:span-4"><div class="card-body">The side - <code>md:span-4</code></div></div>
</div>
```

### As many as fit

`cols-min-240`: as many columns as fit, none narrower than 240 px.

```html
<div class="grid cols-min-160 gap-12">
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">lagoon.example</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">villas.lagoon.example</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">angthong.example</div></div>
</div>
```

## Stacks

`vstack` is a column of items, `hstack` a row of them centered on one line; `gap-*` spaces them and `ms-auto` pushes the rest to the end.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<span class="badge">Draft</span>
	<span class="text-muted">Edited 2 hours ago</span>
	<button class="btn btn-sm ms-auto" type="button">Preview</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="button">Publish</button>
</div>
```

## Regions and breakpoints

Regions are the shell's main and side columns, cards, dialogs, drawers, and any block with the class `region`. A page without the shell marks its own `region`; the root is never one.

| Prefix | The region is at least |
| --- | --- |
| `sm:` | 576 px |
| `md:` | 768 px |
| `lg:` | 1024 px |
| `xl:` | 1280 px |
| `2xl:` | 1536 px |
| `print:` | on paper |

- A region inside a flex row needs a width - `flex-grow-1` or a grid track: its size cannot come from its content.
- A card in the 8-of-12 column at 1440 px is about 740 px wide: `sm:` inside it, not `md:`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `col` | - | grid | equal columns come from the parent's cols-N; the child needs no class |

| `col-auto` | - | review | a column as wide as its content: hstack, or grid-template-columns in the module's CSS |
| `container` | - | review | the shell's app-main, or a region with max-w-* and mx-auto |

| `g-5` | `gap-48` | grid | on the grid parent |

| `gx-4` | `column-gap-24` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-5` | `column-gap-48` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-0` | `row-gap-0` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-1` | `row-gap-4` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-2` | `row-gap-8` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-3` | `row-gap-16` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-4` | `row-gap-24` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-5` | `row-gap-48` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `offset-1` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-10` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-11` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-2` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-3` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-4` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-5` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-6` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-7` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-8` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-9` | - | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `row` | `grid` | grid | on the parent, with cols-N for equal columns or cols-12 for spans; no gutters to undo |
| `row-cols-1` | `cols-1` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-2` | `cols-2` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-3` | `cols-3` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-4` | `cols-4` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-5` | `cols-5` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-6` | `cols-6` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-auto` | - | review | items as wide as their content: hstack flex-wrap |
| `--bs-breakpoint-xs` | - | remove | REDZ.UI's widths are the region prefixes sm: to 2xl: |
| `--bs-gutter-x` | - | review | the grid's gap: gap-* on the grid |
| `--bs-gutter-y` | - | review | the grid's gap: gap-* on the grid |

# Utilities

Single-purpose classes with Bootstrap 5's names, where the number is the value: `p-16`, `gap-8`, `fs-14`, `rounded-8`, `w-50`. Written once from a vocabulary file and committed - nothing is generated where they are used.

## Scales

- Space, in px: 0 2 4 8 12 16 20 24 32 40 48 64 - for `m`, `p` and `gap` with their sides: `mt` `mb` `ms` `me` `mx` `my`, the same for `p`. `ms` and `me` are the start and the end of the line, so they turn right to left.
- Font size: 12 14 16 18 20 24 32; line height: 16 20 24 28; radius: 0 4 6 8 12 16 and `rounded-full`.
- Width prefixes come on placement and spacing - display, flex, grid, gaps, order, text alignment, margins and paddings: `md:d-none`, `lg:p-24`.

## Aspect ratio

`ratio-1x1`, `ratio-4x3`, `ratio-16x9` and `ratio-21x9` keep an element's shape as its width changes - on a video, a map, an image's frame; `ratio-auto` lets it go. The class goes on the element itself: an image inside a frame fills it with `w-100 h-100 object-fit-cover`.

```html
<div class="ratio-16x9 w-50 hstack justify-content-center rounded-8 bg-page text-muted">16 × 9</div>
<div class="ratio-1x1 w-25 hstack justify-content-center rounded-8 bg-page text-muted">1 × 1</div>
```

## Shown when focused

`visually-hidden-focusable` hides an element until it or something in it takes the focus - the first link of a page that jumps to its content. Press `Tab` into the example to see it.

```html
<a class="visually-hidden-focusable btn" href="#utilities-all">Skip to every utility</a>
<span class="text-muted">The link above shows on focus.</span>
```

## Dividers, rules and icon links

`divide-x` and `divide-y` on a parent draw a line between its children, across or down, with no class on any child. `vr` is a rule between the items of a row. `icon-link` lines an icon up with the words of a link.

```html
<div class="hstack divide-x"><span class="px-12">Bookings</span><span class="px-12">Guests</span><span class="px-12">Revenue</span></div>
<div class="hstack gap-12"><button class="btn btn-sm" type="button">Copy</button><span class="vr"></span><button class="btn btn-sm" type="button">Delete</button></div>
<a class="icon-link" href="#utilities-divide"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>Open on the site</a>
```

# Tokens

The custom properties on `:root` that the components read: colors by role in pairs that pass WCAG AA in both themes, spacing, type, radii, shadows and motion. A theme changes tokens, never component rules.

## How they are made

- Colors by role: `--redz-text`, `-muted`, `-faint`; `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-bg`, `-raised`, `-hover`; a tone, its `-subtle` fill and its `-contrast` text for primary, secondary, success, danger, warning and info. `--redz-focus` and `--redz-link` are the primary tone unless a theme gives them their own - a white-label palette sets the links' color in `--redz-link` alone.
- Text is at least 4.5:1 on its background, the borders of fields and the focus ring 3:1, in the light and the dark theme - computed in OKLCH and written as checked hex.
- A component declares a few properties of its own on its root and never on rows or items: hundreds of properties on small elements slow every style recalculation.

## Every token, light theme

# Icons

Bootstrap Icons 1.13.2 under their own class names - `<i class="bi bi-pencil">` - each a CSS mask over its own SVG file: the color of the text around it, no font, no script, no build.

## Examples

An icon takes the size of the text and its color: a utility or the parent sets both.

```html
<i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-trash3 text-danger" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success fs-20" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-stars text-primary fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-chevron-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-arrow-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>
```

The names are Bootstrap Icons' own - look one up at [icons.getbootstrap.com](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/). A name the set does not have paints a filled square, and the checks flag it.

## Accessibility

- An icon beside words is `aria-hidden="true"`. An icon alone takes its meaning from its parent: the button's `aria-label`, or hidden words.
- Icons that point - chevrons, arrows, back and next - mirror right to left with `flip-rtl`; a check, a clock, a search glass, media controls do not.
- Icons keep the forced color of their parent and print in their color.

# From Bootstrap 5.3

Most of Bootstrap 5's names stay. What changes is the spacing numbers, the grid, the breakpoints, states and triggers, and the three components Bootstrap 6 renamed. The two libraries are never on one page: a project switches its stylesheet at once.

## What changes

- **Spacing:** the number is the pixels. `p-3` becomes `p-16`, `mb-2` `mb-8`, `gap-4` `gap-24` - and `p-4` exists in both with another size: Bootstrap's 24 px, REDZ.UI's 4 px. Never rename by chained replacements; rewrite each file once.
- **Grid:** `row` and `col-md-6` become the parent's `grid md:cols-2`; a column's own width is `span-N`.
- **Breakpoints:** the infix becomes a prefix - `d-md-none` is `md:d-none` - and it measures the region, not the window.
- **States:** classes become attributes - `.active` is `aria-current`, `aria-selected` or `aria-pressed`; `.disabled` is `disabled` or `aria-disabled`; `.is-invalid` is `aria-invalid="true"`.
- **Triggers:** `data-bs-toggle` becomes the browser's commands - `commandfor` + `command="show-modal"`, `"close"` or `"toggle-popover"`; `bootstrap.Modal` becomes `dialog.showModal()`.
- **Renamed:** modal → `dialog` on a `<dialog>`, dropdown → `menu` on a popover, offcanvas → `drawer`.
- **Icons:** Bootstrap Icons keep their classes; swap the font's stylesheet for `css/icons.css`.

## With an agent

The skill `redz-ui-from-bootstrap-5` moves a project file by file: `scripts/scan.sh` finds every Bootstrap class, attribute and call with its replacement and checks every class against the vocabulary; the agent rewrites the whole file in one pass, scans it again until nothing is left, and compares the screens before and after. Install it with `npx skills add redz-tech/REDZ.UI`.

Content kept in a database - page bodies an editor wrote long ago - moves once, with no hand on each body: the skill's `scripts/convert.php` (PHP 8.4 or later) rewrites a body by the map, gives a row the columns its children's spans need, follows a few rows by their context (a badge's tone, a compact table, a lead paragraph, white text on a tone) and lists what it left for a person to decide.

## The map

Every class of Bootstrap 5.3.8 that changes, with what it becomes; a class not listed keeps its name, and a breakpoint form follows its class - `mb-md-3` is `md:mb-16`. The full map, every class and form, is the skill's `assets/map.tsv`.

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accordion-button` | - | remove | the summary is the button; its chevron is <i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon"> |
| `accordion-collapse` | - | remove | the body follows the summary inside the <details> |
| `accordion-header` | `accordion-header` | review | the item's <summary> with the button's words in it; no heading and no button inside |
| `accordion-item` | `accordion-item` | review | a <details>; the items of one group share a name, as data-bs-parent did |
| `active` | - | state | aria-current, aria-selected or aria-pressed: the attribute of the element's role |
| `alert-dark` | - | review | the plain alert, or a tone |
| `alert-dismissible` | - | review | a btn-close at the end, removed by your script |
| `alert-heading` | - | review | a strong title in the alert's div |
| `alert-light` | - | review | the plain alert, or a tone |
| `alert-link` | - | review | a plain link |
| `alert-secondary` | - | review | the plain alert, or a tone |
| `bg-black` | - | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |
| `bg-body-secondary` | `bg-page` | rename |  |
| `bg-body-tertiary` | `bg-raised` | rename |  |
| `bg-dark` | - | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |
| `bg-dark-subtle` | - | review | bg-page, or a tone's -subtle |
| `bg-gradient` | - | remove | no gradients |
| `bg-light` | - | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |
| `bg-light-subtle` | - | review | bg-page, or a tone's -subtle |
| `bg-opacity-10` | - | review | Bootstrap 6 dropped it too: bg-{tone}-subtle |
| `bg-opacity-100` | - | review | Bootstrap 6 dropped it too: bg-{tone}-subtle |
| `bg-opacity-25` | - | review | Bootstrap 6 dropped it too: bg-{tone}-subtle |

# Buttons

A button runs an action; a link drawn as a button goes somewhere. One class, `btn`, then a tone, a size or an icon when the button needs one.

## Examples

The plain `btn` is neutral. `btn-primary` marks the one main action of a screen; the other tones say what an action does.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save</button>
<button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button">Duplicate</button>
<button class="btn btn-success" type="button">Publish</button>
<button class="btn btn-danger" type="button">Delete</button>
<button class="btn btn-warning" type="button">Withdraw</button>
<button class="btn btn-info" type="button">Preview</button>
```

### Outline, subtle, text and link

Quieter forms of the same tones for secondary actions, rows and toolbars. `btn-text` has no fill until hovered; `btn-link` reads as a link and keeps a button's size.

```html
<button class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="button">Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline-danger" type="button">Outline danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle-primary" type="button">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle-danger" type="button">Subtle danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-text" type="button">Text</button>
<button class="btn btn-link" type="button">Link</button>
```

### Sizes

A size is a word: `btn-xs` 24 px, `btn-sm` 28 px, the default 32 px, `btn-lg` 40 px - the heights of every control of the same size.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button">Extra small</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button">Small</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Default</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" type="button">Large</button>
```

### Icons

An icon sits beside the words, or alone in a square `btn-icon` whose name is its `aria-label`. `btn-close` draws the close glyph by itself.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>New excursion</button>
<a class="btn" href="#btn-icons">Open the site<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Edit"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="More actions"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm btn-subtle-danger" type="button" aria-label="Remove"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button>
```

### Groups and toolbars

`btn-group` joins buttons into one control - here a choice of view, each button pressed or not. `btn-toolbar` lays groups and buttons out in a wrapping row.

```html
<div class="btn-toolbar" role="group" aria-label="List view">
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Layout">
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="true">List</button>
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Board</button>
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Calendar</button>
	</div>
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Export">
		<button class="btn" type="button">Export</button>
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Export options"><i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
</div>
```

`btn-group-vertical` stacks the buttons of a group, each as wide as the widest.

```html
<div class="btn-group-vertical" role="group" aria-label="Order">
	<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-arrow-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move up</button>
	<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move down</button>
	<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-trash" aria-hidden="true"></i>Remove</button>
</div>
```

### Toggle and busy

A toggle carries `aria-pressed`. While its action runs, `REDZ.ui.busy(button, promise)` shows a spinner in the button and marks it `aria-disabled`: it keeps the focus and ignores clicks until the promise settles.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-docs-run="toggle"><i class="bi bi-pin-angle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Pin</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-docs-run="busy-button">Save for 2 seconds</button>
```

## States

A state is the attribute accessibility needs anyway, on the button itself: no `active` or `disabled` classes. `aria-expanded` is set by the browser on a button that opens a menu or a dialog.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- `<button type="button">` for an action, `<a href>` for a place; `btn` draws both the same. Enter and Space press a button, Enter follows a link.
- A button with only an icon takes its name from `aria-label`; the icon is `aria-hidden="true"`.
- `disabled` takes a button out of the tab order and hides why. `aria-disabled="true"` keeps it focusable - so a tooltip can say why - and the library swallows its clicks.
- A button that opens a menu or a dialog uses the browser's command: `commandfor` + `command`, never `data-bs-toggle`.
- The focus ring is 2 px of `--redz-focus`, 3:1 against the page in both themes.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/btn.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/btn.css). It declares `--redz-btn-bg`, `--redz-btn-fg`, `--redz-btn-hover`, `--redz-btn-hover-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-secondary-contrast`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-success-contrast`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-danger-contrast`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-warning-contrast`, `--redz-info`, `--redz-info-contrast`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-info-subtle`, `--redz-control-height-xs`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-control-height-lg`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-motion`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `btn-check` | - | review | a toggle is a btn with aria-pressed; a choice is radio inputs |
| `btn-close-white` | - | remove | the close glyph takes the text color |
| `btn-dark` | - | review | no light or dark buttons: btn or btn-text |
| `btn-light` | - | review | no light or dark buttons: btn or btn-text |
| `btn-outline-dark` | - | review | btn-outline-secondary |
| `btn-outline-light` | - | review | btn-outline-secondary |
| `data-bs-toggle="button"` | `aria-pressed` | review | switch aria-pressed in your click handler |

# Chips

A chip is a small rounded choice: a filter that is on or off, a saved view, an applied filter with its count and a way to remove it.

## Examples

A filter chip is a toggle button: `aria-pressed` says whether it is on. A chip that opens a menu is the menu's button.

```html
<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true"><i class="bi bi-eye" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</button>
<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i>Drafts</button>
<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><i class="bi bi-translate" aria-hidden="true"></i>Language: any</button>
<button class="chip" type="button" commandfor="chip-site-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Site: all<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<div id="chip-site-menu" class="menu menu-start" popover role="menu" aria-label="Site">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true">All sites</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">lagoon.example</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">angthong.example</button>
</div>
```

### Saved views and applied filters

Links between saved views mark the current one with `aria-current="true"`. An applied filter is a group: its name, its count in `chip-count`, and a `chip-dismiss` button named after what it removes.

```html
<a class="chip" href="#chip-views" aria-current="true">All<span class="chip-count">28</span></a>
<a class="chip" href="#chip-views">Needs attention<span class="chip-count">3</span></a>
<a class="chip" href="#chip-views">Mine<span class="chip-count">11</span></a>
<span class="chip" role="group" aria-label="Filter: section Marine"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Section: Marine<span class="chip-count">9</span><button class="chip-dismiss" type="button" aria-label="Remove filter: section Marine"><i class="bi bi-x" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></span>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- A filter chip is a `<button>` with `aria-pressed`; Space or Enter toggles it. Change the attribute when the filter changes - the look follows it.
- A saved view is a link; the current one carries `aria-current="true"`.
- An applied filter is `role="group"` named after the filter, and its dismiss button names what it removes - "Remove filter: section Marine", not "Remove".
- A count is part of the chip's name; say what it counts in the words around it when it is not obvious.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/chip.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/chip.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-text-muted`.

# Menus

A menu is a short list of actions or choices that opens from a button: the browser's popover, placed beside the button by CSS anchor positioning, driven by the keyboard as the WAI-ARIA menu button.

## Examples

The button opens the menu with the browser's command - `commandfor` names the menu, `command="toggle-popover"` opens and closes it - and the library keeps its `aria-expanded`, which Firefox does not give such a button. No script is needed to open a menu; the library adds the arrow keys.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="menu-actions-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i>Actions</button>
<div id="menu-actions-list" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Actions">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i>Edit</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-files" aria-hidden="true"></i>Duplicate</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true"><i class="bi bi-archive" aria-hidden="true"></i>Archive</button>
	<a class="menu-item" href="#menu-actions" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>Open on the site</a>
	<hr class="menu-divider">
	<button class="menu-item menu-item-danger" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Delete</button>
</div>
```

### Choices and headers

A choice of one is a set of `menuitemradio` items, the chosen one `aria-checked="true"` with a check drawn after it. `menu-header` titles a part of the menu. `menu-start` lines the menu up with its button's start edge instead of its end.

```html
<button class="btn btn-text" type="button" commandfor="menu-choice-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><span class="dot dot-success"></span>All sites<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<div id="menu-choice-list" class="menu menu-start" popover role="menu" aria-label="Work context">
	<div class="menu-header">Work context</div>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true"><i class="bi bi-grid-3x3-gap" aria-hidden="true"></i>All sites</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>lagoon.example</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>angthong.example</button>
</div>
```

## States

The items of an open menu. `:focus-visible` is where the arrow keys are; `aria-current="true"` marks the page a menu of links is on.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the button | In the menu |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the menu, the focus on the checked or the first item | Runs the item and closes the menu |
| `↓` / `↑` | Opens the menu on the first / the last item | The next / the previous item, round the ends |
| `Home` / `End` | - | The first / the last item |
| A letter | - | The next item that begins with it |
| `Esc` | - | Closes the menu, the focus back on the button |
| `Tab` | - | Closes the menu and moves on |

- The menu is `popover` with `role="menu"` and a name; its items are `menuitem`, `menuitemradio` or `menuitemcheckbox`. A list of site sections is navigation, not a menu - use links.
- The button carries `aria-haspopup="menu"`; the library keeps its `aria-expanded`, and the browser moves the focus back to it on close and closes the menu on a click outside or `Esc`.
- Where an engine does not put the menu beside its button - no anchor positioning below Firefox 147 and Safari 26, no anchor from a popover's button in Chrome 130-132, a table cell in Chrome 135-136, the bottom of a long page in Safari 26 - `js/menu-place.js` places it, again when the page scrolls or the menu or its button changes size, and the probes record each such place.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/menu.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/menu.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-2`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dropdown` | - | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropdown-center` | - | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropdown-divider` | `menu-divider` | rename |  |
| `dropdown-header` | `menu-header` | rename |  |
| `dropdown-item` | `menu-item` | rename | role="menuitem" |
| `dropdown-item-text` | - | review | menu-header, or plain text |
| `dropdown-menu` | `menu` | rename | with popover and role="menu" |
| `dropdown-menu-dark` | - | remove | the theme sets it |
| `dropdown-menu-end` | - | remove | the menu meets its button's end edge by default |
| `dropdown-menu-start` | `menu-start` | rename |  |
| `dropdown-toggle` | - | review | the button: commandfor + command="toggle-popover" + aria-haspopup="menu"; a chevron is an icon |
| `dropdown-toggle-split` | - | review | a btn-group of the action and a btn-icon that opens the menu |
| `dropend` | - | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropstart` | - | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropup` | - | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropup-center` | - | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `data-bs-toggle="dropdown"` | `commandfor="ID" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"` | trigger | the menu gets popover and role="menu" |
| `data-bs-placement` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-offset` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-auto-close` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-display` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-reference` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-boundary` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-popper-config` | - | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `bootstrap.Dropdown` | `menu.showPopover(), menu.hidePopover(), menu.togglePopover()` | trigger |  |
| `show.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |
| `shown.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |
| `hide.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |
| `hidden.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |

# Form fields

Text fields, selects and text areas with Bootstrap 5's names: a label floating in the field or above it, a hint, an error said in words, an icon inside the field.

## Examples

`form-floating` keeps the label inside the field and lifts it when the field has a value or the focus. The label follows the control, and the control needs a `placeholder` - it is how CSS knows the field is empty.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<input class="form-control" id="form-floating-name" value="Ang Thong: marine park by speedboat" placeholder="A name people search for">
	<label for="form-floating-name">Name</label>
</div>
<div class="form-floating">
	<input class="form-control" id="form-floating-mail" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com">
	<label for="form-floating-mail">E-mail</label>
</div>
<div class="form-floating">
	<select class="form-select" id="form-floating-section"><option>Marine</option><option>Land</option><option>Evening</option></select>
	<label for="form-floating-section">Section</label>
</div>
<div class="form-floating">
	<textarea class="form-control" id="form-floating-note" placeholder="A note for the guides">Pick up at the pier at 8:30.</textarea>
	<label for="form-floating-note">Note</label>
</div>
```

### A label above, a hint, an error

`form-field` stacks a field's parts: `form-label`, the control, `form-text` for a hint and `invalid-feedback` for an error. The control points at both with `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid="true"`, and the browser's own `:user-invalid` draws the same after the person has edited the field.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-stacked-slug">Address</label>
	<input class="form-control font-monospace" id="form-stacked-slug" value="ang-thong" aria-describedby="form-stacked-slug-hint">
	<div class="form-text" id="form-stacked-slug-hint">Full address /excursions/ang-thong/. The old one answers with a 301 redirect.</div>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-stacked-price">Adult price, THB</label>
	<input class="form-control tabular-nums" id="form-stacked-price" type="number" value="2500" min="0" step="100" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="form-stacked-price-error">
	<div class="invalid-feedback" id="form-stacked-price-error"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Lower than the child price</div>
</div>
```

### An icon in the field

`form-adorn` puts an icon inside a field, at its start; the field keeps its own name.

```html
<div class="form-adorn">
	<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
	<input class="form-control" type="search" placeholder="Name, slug or code" aria-label="Search excursions">
</div>
```

### Sizes

`form-control-sm` and `form-select-sm` are 28 px high, the default 32 px, `-lg` 40 px - the same heights as the buttons beside them.

```html
<input class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Small" aria-label="Small field">
<input class="form-control" placeholder="Default" aria-label="Default field">
<input class="form-control form-control-lg" placeholder="Large" aria-label="Large field">
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" aria-label="Small select"><option>Small select</option></select>
```

### A one-time code

`form-control-otp` spaces the digits of a code from an app or a message in one field. One field takes a paste and the code the system offers above the keyboard - a box per digit takes neither - and the form goes by its button, never by the last digit.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-otp-code">6-digit code from your app</label>
	<input class="form-control form-control-otp" id="form-otp-code" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" pattern="[0-9 \-]*" spellcheck="false" enterkeyhint="done" aria-describedby="form-otp-code-hint">
	<div class="form-text" id="form-otp-code-hint">Spaces and dashes are fine.</div>
</div>
```

### A new password

A button with `command="--reveal"` for a password field shows its text and hides it again - `aria-pressed` says which - and the field hides it on its form's submit and when the page comes back from the history. Each element with `data-strength` naming the field shows its level as it is typed: shorter than its `minlength`, long enough, then longer or of three kinds of characters, then both - a `meter` at once, and the words, the page's texts `strength.short`, `.fair`, `.good` and `.strong`, once the typing pauses, said politely by a live region of the field's own - VoiceOver says nothing of a password field's own description changing, so the words' element needs no `aria-live`. The level is a hint: the server keeps its own rules.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-password-new">New password</label>
	<div class="input-group">
		<input class="form-control" id="form-password-new" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="12" spellcheck="false" aria-describedby="form-password-hint form-password-level">
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" commandfor="form-password-new" command="--reveal" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Show the password"><i class="bi bi-eye" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<meter class="meter" min="0" max="4" low="2" high="3" optimum="4" value="0" data-strength="form-password-new" aria-label="Password strength"></meter>
	<div class="form-text" id="form-password-level" data-strength="form-password-new"></div>
	<div class="form-text" id="form-password-hint">At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few words is easy to remember.</div>
</div>
```

### A range

`form-range` on an `<input type="range">` is the browser's own slider in the theme's accent: it keeps its keys (the arrows, `Home`, `End`, `Page Up` and `Page Down`) and its look in forced colors. The label says what it sets; when the number matters, write it beside the slider.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-range-quality">Photo quality</label>
	<input class="form-range" id="form-range-quality" type="range" min="40" max="100" step="5" value="80">
</div>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Every control has a visible label: a `<label for>`, or `aria-label` only where the context says it all - a search field with its icon.
- A placeholder is never the label: it goes away as the person types. In `form-floating` the placeholder is only the empty marker.
- An error is said in words in `invalid-feedback`, joined to the control by `aria-describedby`; a color alone never tells it.
- The borders of fields and the focus ring are at least 3:1 against the page in both themes; the text 4.5:1.
- `form-select` paints its own chevron from the theme, mirrored right to left; a multiple select or one with `size` drops it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/form.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/form.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-form-select-chevron`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-control-height-lg`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-control-height-float`, `--redz-fs-14`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`, `--redz-primary`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `col-form-label` | `form-label` | review | a form-label in a form-field |
| `form-control-color` | - | review | a native <input type="color"> in the module's CSS |
| `form-control-plaintext` | - | review | readonly on a form-control, or plain text |
| `has-validation` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `invalid-tooltip` | `invalid-feedback` | review | the error under the field |
| `is-invalid` | - | state | aria-invalid="true" on the control |
| `is-valid` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-feedback` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-tooltip` | - | remove | fields have no success state |
| `was-validated` | - | state | the browser's :user-invalid shows after the person edits |

# Input groups

A field joined to what belongs to it - a unit, a prefix, a button, a choice - into one control. The borders meet by themselves; a menu or a hidden element inside the group is left out of the joining.

## Examples

`input-group` around a `form-control` or a `form-select` and its parts: `input-group-text` for words and icons, a `btn` for an action. An icon inside the field itself is [`form-adorn`](form.md).

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<input class="form-control" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2,500" aria-label="Adult price" aria-describedby="input-group-basic-unit">
	<span class="input-group-text" id="input-group-basic-unit">THB</span>
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<span class="input-group-text">https://</span>
	<input class="form-control" type="text" value="angthong.example" aria-label="Site address">
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<input class="form-control" type="text" value="R7K2-9QXM" readonly aria-label="Access code">
	<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i>Copy</button>
</div>
```

### With a choice

A `form-select` or a check joins the same way; a check goes inside an `input-group-text`.

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<select class="form-select" aria-label="Currency">
		<option>THB</option>
		<option>USD</option>
		<option>EUR</option>
	</select>
	<input class="form-control" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1,900" aria-label="Child price">
</div>
<div class="input-group">
	<label class="input-group-text"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Discount</label>
	<input class="form-control" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="10" aria-label="Discount, percent">
	<span class="input-group-text">%</span>
</div>
```

### With a menu

The menu sits in the group beside its button; the group joins only what it shows.

```html
<div class="input-group">
	<input class="form-control" type="search" placeholder="Search excursions" aria-label="Search excursions">
	<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="input-group-menu-in" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu">Everywhere<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	<div id="input-group-menu-in" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Search in">
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true">Everywhere</button>
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">Titles</button>
		<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">Descriptions</button>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Small, in a field

`input-group-sm` sizes every part of the group; `form-field` carries the label, the hint and the error outside it.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="input-group-field-months">Free months</label>
	<div class="input-group input-group-sm">
		<input class="form-control" id="input-group-field-months" type="text" inputmode="numeric" value="3" aria-describedby="input-group-field-hint">
		<span class="input-group-text">months</span>
		<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Remove"><i class="bi bi-trash" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<div class="form-text" id="input-group-field-hint">Given with a yearly plan.</div>
</div>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Every field of a group has its own name - a `<label>` or `aria-label`. The words beside it are not its name: point at a unit with `aria-describedby`, so it reads as “Adult price, 2,500, THB”.
- The parts keep their own keys: `Tab` goes from the field to its button, a menu opens as every [menu](menu.md) does.
- An error goes under the group, in its `form-field`, never inside it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/input-group.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/input-group.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-fs-12`.

# Checks, radios and switches

The browser's own checkbox and radio, drawn by the library: `check`, `radio` and `switch` on the input itself, `form-check` on the label around it.

## Examples

The class goes on the `<input>`; the label wraps it, so a click anywhere on the words toggles it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Included</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Transfer</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Lunch</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox">Kayaks</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Radios

Radios with one `name` are one choice; the arrow keys move it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Departure</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time" checked>Morning, 8:30</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Noon, 12:00</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Sunset, 16:30</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Switches

A switch is a checkbox with `role="switch"`: on or off, applied at once. One that cannot change keeps its focus with `aria-disabled="true"` and says why in a hint.

```html
<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked>Show on the site</label>
<div class="vstack gap-4">
	<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-disabled="true" aria-describedby="check-switches-why">Hide “Powered by REDZ CMS”</label>
	<div class="form-text" id="check-switches-why"><i class="bi bi-lock" aria-hidden="true"></i> Available with a partner license</div>
</div>
```

## States

A check with some of its items chosen is `indeterminate` - a property set from script, as there is no attribute for it.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Space toggles a check or a switch; the arrow keys move the choice among radios of one `name`.
- A set of checks or radios sits in a `<fieldset>` whose `<legend>` names it.
- The marks are drawn from the browser's own `:checked` and `:indeterminate`, and keep showing in forced colors and in print.
- `aria-disabled="true"` keeps the control focusable and readable, so its hint can say why; the library ignores clicks and Space on it, as on a button so marked.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/check.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/check.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form-check-inline` | - | review | hstack gap-16 around the labels |
| `form-check-input` | - | review | check, radio or switch on the input, by its type |
| `form-check-label` | - | remove | the label is the form-check around the input |
| `form-check-reverse` | - | missing |  |
| `form-switch` | - | review | switch on the input, with role="switch" |

# Combobox

A choice from a list long enough to search: a button in the look of a select shows the value and opens a panel with a search field and the list. One core - the WAI-ARIA combobox with a listbox - also drives the command palette and a list in the page.

## Examples

The face is a button with `role="combobox"` that opens its panel by the browser's command; the panel is a popover with the search, the `listbox` and the value: one hidden field per chosen value, named by the list's `data-name`, so a form posts it as it is. Typing filters the list - case and accents aside, every word found, the best first - and the arrow keys move the active option while the focus stays in the search.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-one-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-one-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Choose a language…">Thai</span></button>
	<label for="combobox-one-face">Default language</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-one-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Default language">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-one-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a language" placeholder="Find a language" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-one-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Languages" data-name="language">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-en" data-value="en" aria-selected="false">English</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-th" data-value="th" aria-selected="true">Thai</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ru" data-value="ru" aria-selected="false">Russian</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-de" data-value="de" aria-selected="false">German</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-fr" data-value="fr" aria-selected="false">French</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-es" data-value="es" aria-selected="false">Spanish</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-zh" data-value="zh" aria-selected="false">Chinese</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ja" data-value="ja" aria-selected="false">Japanese</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ko" data-value="ko" aria-selected="false">Korean</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-ar" data-value="ar" aria-selected="false">Arabic</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-he" data-value="he" aria-selected="false">Hebrew</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-one-vi" data-value="vi" aria-selected="false">Vietnamese</div>
	</div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
	<input type="hidden" name="language" value="th" data-label="Thai">
</div>
```

### Many - a list on the button

A list with `aria-multiselectable="true"` keeps its panel open while options are chosen, and a field `name[]` holds each value. The button lists them in the page's language - "English, Thai, and Russian" - while they fit, else the first ones and the count of the rest.

```html
<div class="form-floating">

	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-many-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Languages" aria-multiselectable="true" data-name="languages[]">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-en" data-value="en" aria-selected="true">English</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-many-th" data-value="th" aria-selected="true">Thai</div>
```

### Tags that create values

A list with `data-create` ends with “Create …” while the search's words are no option's label and no chosen one - the page's text `create`. Taken, the new label is held in a hidden field `data-create` names, beside the list's own; the search empties for the next one. A page that makes the value on its server cancels `redz:create` on the list and answers with a promise of `{value, label}`: the list is busy until it settles, the new value is an option from then on - or, rejected, its words are said.

```html
<div class="vstack gap-8">
	<div class="form-floating">
		<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-tags-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-tags-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Add a tag…"></span></button>
		<label for="combobox-tags-face">Tags</label>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-chips" id="combobox-tags-chips"></div>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-tags-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Tags">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-tags-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find or create a tag" placeholder="Find or create a tag" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-tags-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Tags" aria-multiselectable="true" data-name="tags[]" data-create="tags_new[]" data-chips="combobox-tags-chips">
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-tags-family" data-value="family" aria-selected="true">Family</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-tags-sunset" data-value="sunset" aria-selected="false">Sunset</div>
		<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-tags-vegan" data-value="vegan" aria-selected="false">Vegetarian lunch</div>
	</div>
	<input type="hidden" name="tags[]" value="family" data-label="Family">
</div>
```

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:create', (event) => {
	if (event.target.id !== 'tags') {
		return; // the new label goes into the field data-create names
	}
	event.preventDefault();
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch('/tags', {method: 'POST', body: new URLSearchParams({label: event.detail.label})})
		.then((answer) => answer.ok ? answer.json() : Promise.reject('The tag could not be made')));
});
```

### Groups, descriptions and icons

Options sit in groups - `role="group"` named by its `menu-header` - and carry an icon and a `menu-item-description`, which the search reads too; `data-keywords` adds words the option answers without showing them, and `aria-disabled="true"` keeps an option out of reach.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-groups-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-groups-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Choose a role…">Editor</span></button>
	<label for="combobox-groups-face">Role</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-groups-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Role">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-groups-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a role" placeholder="Find a role" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-groups-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Roles" data-name="role">
		<div role="group" aria-labelledby="combobox-groups-content">
			<div class="menu-header" id="combobox-groups-content" role="presentation">Content</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-editor" data-value="editor" data-label="Editor" aria-selected="true"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Editor</span><span class="menu-item-description">Writes and publishes pages</span></span></div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-translator" data-value="translator" data-label="Translator" data-keywords="languages" aria-selected="false"><i class="bi bi-translate" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Translator</span><span class="menu-item-description">Translates what editors write</span></span></div>
		</div>
		<div role="group" aria-labelledby="combobox-groups-site">
			<div class="menu-header" id="combobox-groups-site" role="presentation">Site</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-manager" data-value="manager" data-label="Site manager" aria-selected="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Site manager</span><span class="menu-item-description">Runs one site and its settings</span></span></div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-groups-owner" data-value="owner" data-label="Owner" aria-selected="false" aria-disabled="true"><i class="bi bi-key" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="menu-item-content"><span>Owner</span><span class="menu-item-description">Only an owner gives this role</span></span></div>
		</div>
	</div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
	<input type="hidden" name="role" value="editor" data-label="Editor">
</div>
```

### Options from the server

A page that finds options itself listens for `redz:search` on the search and cancels it: the list is marked `aria-busy` until the page puts its options in - or sets `aria-busy="false"` when it cannot. This example answers from a short list after 400 ms.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<button class="form-select combobox-toggle" type="button" id="combobox-remote-face" role="combobox" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" commandfor="combobox-remote-panel" command="toggle-popover"><span class="combobox-value" data-placeholder="Find a person…"></span></button>
	<label for="combobox-remote-face">Assigned to</label>
</div>
<div class="menu combobox-menu" id="combobox-remote-panel" popover role="dialog" aria-label="Assigned to">
	<div class="combobox-search">
		<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<input class="form-control form-control-sm combobox-search-input" type="search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-remote-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a person" placeholder="Find a person" autocomplete="off" autofocus>
	</div>
	<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-remote-list" role="listbox" aria-label="People" data-name="assignee" data-docs-remote></div>
	<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nobody found</p>
</div>
```

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:search', (event) => {
	const list = document.getElementById(event.target.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
	if (list.id !== 'people' || event.detail.query.length < 2) {
		return; // the library filters the options it has
	}
	event.preventDefault();
	const {query, signal} = event.detail; // signal aborts when the query changes or the panel closes
	fetch('/people?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query), {signal})
		.then((answer) => answer.json())
		.then((people) => list.replaceChildren(...people.map(option)))
		.catch(() => signal.aborted || list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false'));
});
```

### A list in the page

The same search and list without a button and a panel - a filter in a side column, a long choice in a settings page.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<input class="form-control" type="search" role="combobox" aria-controls="combobox-inline-list" aria-expanded="true" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Find a time zone" placeholder="Find a time zone" autocomplete="off">
		<div class="combobox-list" id="combobox-inline-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Time zones" data-name="zone">
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-bkk" data-value="Asia/Bangkok" aria-selected="true">Bangkok · UTC+7</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-sgp" data-value="Asia/Singapore" aria-selected="false">Singapore · UTC+8</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-dxb" data-value="Asia/Dubai" aria-selected="false">Dubai · UTC+4</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-msk" data-value="Europe/Moscow" aria-selected="false">Moscow · UTC+3</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-ber" data-value="Europe/Berlin" aria-selected="false">Berlin · UTC+1</div>
			<div class="menu-item" role="option" id="combobox-inline-nyc" data-value="America/New_York" aria-selected="false">New York · UTC−5</div>
		</div>
		<p class="combobox-no-results" hidden>Nothing found</p>
		<input type="hidden" name="zone" value="Asia/Bangkok" data-label="Bangkok · UTC+7">
	</div>
</div>
```

## States

The button carries a field's states; an option is active where the arrow keys are - `data-active`, which the library sets - and chosen by `aria-selected="true"`.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the button | In the search |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the panel, the focus in its search | `Enter` takes the active option: one closes the panel, many stay |
| `↓` / `↑` | Opens the panel | The next / the previous option, round the ends; the first press goes to the chosen option |
| `Page Down` / `Page Up` | - | Ten options on / back |
| A letter | Opens the panel with the letter in the search | Types; the first match becomes active |
| `Esc` | - | Empties the search; on an empty search, closes the panel, the focus back on the button |
| `Tab` | - | Closes the panel and moves on |

- The button is the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox: named by its `<label for>`, its value its text, its popup a panel with `role="dialog"`; the library keeps its `aria-expanded`, and its `aria-controls` only while the panel is open - VoiceOver otherwise reads the value from the closed list, not from the button.
- The search is the editable combobox with list autocomplete: the focus stays in it, `aria-activedescendant` names the active option, `aria-selected` marks the chosen ones. The list follows the search in the page, so a screen reader on a phone reaches it by swiping.
- Once the typing pauses, the option `Enter` would take is said politely by its label - a screen reader busy with the typed keys says nothing of it - and with nothing found, the count, from the page's texts. The probes' engine `voiceover` holds these words against what VoiceOver says in Safari.
- A choice fires `input` and `change` on the list; a form's reset puts the values back as the page sent them.

## Texts

The library has no words of its own; it reads these from the page's island `#redz-ui-text`. A count takes the form the page language's plural rules name - `found.one`, `found.few`, `found.many` - and `found.other` when the page gives no such form.

| Key | For | In English |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `remove` | A chip's remove button; `{label}` is the value's label | Remove {label} |
| `create` | The option of a list with `data-create`; `{label}` is the search's words | Create “{label}” |
| `found.one`, `found.other` | The count of options found; `{count}` in the page's digits | {count} result, {count} results |

## Tokens

From [`css/components/combobox.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/combobox.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`.

# Inline edit

A value changed where it shows - a title in a list, a name on a page - behind a real Edit button, in a small form of its own that saves or cancels.

## Examples

The value has an id; the Edit button names the form by `commandfor` with `command="--edit"`; the form, of class `inline-edit-form`, names the value by `data-for` and holds the field, its Save button and a Cancel button with `command="--cancel"`. `--edit` shows the form in place of the value, the field focused and its text selected; `Enter` saves, `Esc` or Cancel puts the field back, and the focus returns to the Edit button. A click elsewhere leaves the form open.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="inline-edit-row-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="inline-edit-row-title">Excursions</h2></div>
	<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
		<div class="list-group-item hstack gap-8">
			<span class="table-title flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-1">Ang Thong: marine park by speedboat</span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-1-form" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the title: Ang Thong"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<form class="inline-edit-form flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-1-form" data-for="inline-edit-row-1" hidden>
				<input class="form-control form-control-sm" name="title" value="Ang Thong: marine park by speedboat" aria-label="Title" required>
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-1-form" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
				<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
			</form>
		</div>
		<div class="list-group-item hstack gap-8">
			<span class="table-title flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-2">Night market and street food</span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-2-form" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the title: Night market"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<form class="inline-edit-form flex-fill" id="inline-edit-row-2-form" data-for="inline-edit-row-2" data-docs-save hidden>
				<input class="form-control form-control-sm" name="title" value="Night market and street food" aria-label="Title">
				<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
				<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-row-2-form" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
				<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
			</form>
		</div>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Saved by the page

The form's submit fires `redz:save` on it, with the form and the field's value. A page that saves cancels it and answers with a promise: the Save button is busy until it settles - resolved, the value shows the saved text and the form closes; rejected with words, the form stays open, the field marked invalid and the words in its `invalid-feedback`, said at once. Left alone, the value shows the text and the field keeps it. The second row above answers after 600 ms and refuses an empty title.

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:save', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch(event.detail.form.action, {method: 'POST', body: new FormData(event.detail.form)})
		.then((answer) => answer.ok ? answer.text() : answer.text().then((words) => Promise.reject(words))));
});
```

### Inside another form

A form cannot sit in a form: where the value lives in one - a settings page with a save bar - the edit form is a `popover="manual"` placed outside it, with the class `menu` for its panel; `--edit` opens it beside the Edit button.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<span class="fs-16 fw-600" id="inline-edit-popover-name">Lagoon Tours</span>
	<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-popover-form" command="--edit" aria-label="Edit the company's name"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</div>
<form class="menu inline-edit-form" id="inline-edit-popover-form" data-for="inline-edit-popover-name" popover="manual">
	<input class="form-control form-control-sm" name="company" value="Lagoon Tours" aria-label="The company's name" required>
	<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="submit">Save</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="inline-edit-popover-form" command="--cancel">Cancel</button>
	<div class="invalid-feedback" hidden></div>
</form>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` on Edit | Opens the form, the focus in the field, its text selected |
| `Enter` in the field | Saves |
| `Esc` | Puts the field back and closes the form, the focus on Edit |

- Edit is a real button named after what it edits - the value's own text may be a link to its record and stays one.
- The form saves only by its Save button or `Enter`: a blur never commits half an edit, and never throws one away.
- A refused save keeps the focus in the field; `invalid-feedback` takes `role="alert"`, so the page's words are said at once, and the field names it in `aria-describedby`.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/inline-edit.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/inline-edit.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`.

# File upload

Photos, documents, a price list: chosen, dropped or pasted, each file checked at once and sent on its own, with its own progress and its own error.

## Examples

`upload` holds the file input, an `upload-zone` button that opens it and takes files dropped on it, a `<template>` of one file's row and an `upload-list`. A paste while the focus is in the upload takes the clipboard's files. Each file is checked against the input's `accept` and the upload's `data-max-size` in bytes; a refusal shows in the file's row, the page's text `file.type` or `file.size`. A file dropped beside the zone does not open in the window.

```html
<div class="upload" data-max-size="2097152" data-docs-upload>
	<input class="visually-hidden" id="upload-photos-input" type="file" name="photos[]" accept="image/*,.pdf" multiple tabindex="-1" aria-label="Photos">
	<button class="upload-zone" type="button" aria-describedby="upload-photos-hint">
		<i class="bi bi-cloud-arrow-up fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i>
		<span>Drop photos here, or choose them</span>
		<span class="fs-12" id="upload-photos-hint">JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 2 MB each</span>
	</button>
	<ul class="upload-list" aria-label="Files"></ul>
	<template>
		<li>
			<i class="bi bi-file-earmark-image" aria-hidden="true"></i>
			<span class="flex-fill" data-file-name></span>
			<progress class="progress" max="1" value="0" aria-label="Sent"></progress>
			<span class="invalid-feedback" data-file-error></span>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" data-file-remove><i class="bi bi-x-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		</li>
	</template>
</div>
```

### Sent by the page

Each file fires `redz:files` on the upload with the file, its row, `progress(fraction)` for the row's bar and a `signal` its remove button aborts. A page that sends cancels it and answers with a promise: resolved, the row is done; rejected, the page's words show in the row's `data-file-error`. One file's error leaves the others. Left alone, the file joins the input's files and goes with the form. The example above answers in a second and a half.

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:files', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	const {file, progress, signal} = event.detail;
	event.detail.respondWith(new Promise((sent, failed) => {
		const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
		request.open('POST', '/files');
		request.upload.onprogress = (step) => progress(step.loaded / step.total);
		request.onload = () => (request.status === 200 ? sent() : failed(request.responseText));
		request.onerror = () => failed('The file did not arrive');
		signal.addEventListener('abort', () => request.abort());
		request.send(file);
	}));
});
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The zone is one real button: `Enter` or `Space` opens the browser's picker; the input itself stays out of the Tab order, and its words - which follow the browser's language, not the page's - never show.
- A refused or failed file says why in its row, at once; a removed file's focus goes to the next file's remove button, else to the zone.
- Each remove button is named after its file, from the page's text `remove`.

## Texts

| Key | For | In English |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file.type` | A file the input's `accept` does not take; `{name}` is its name | {name} is not a kind of file this takes |
| `file.size` | A file over `data-max-size`; `{size}` the limit in the page's units | {name} is larger than {size} |
| `remove` | A file's remove button | Remove {label} |

## Tokens

From [`css/components/upload.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/upload.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-space-24`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-bg-hover`.

# Cards

A card is a bordered region of a screen: a header with its title and actions, a body, a footer. It is a region - the width prefixes inside it measure the card, not the window.

## Examples

A card that is a section of the screen is a `<section>` named by its heading. The header holds an icon, the title and whatever belongs to it; the footer holds the card's actions.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-basic-title">
	<div class="card-header"><i class="bi bi-cash-coin" aria-hidden="true"></i><h2 id="card-basic-title">Price</h2><span class="text-muted fs-12">in the base currency THB</span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.</p>
		<p class="text-muted">The visitor's currency is an estimate.</p>
	</div>
	<div class="card-footer justify-content-end">
		<button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save</button>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Images

`card-img-top` and `card-img-bottom` round the image with the card's corners; `card-img-overlay` lays the card's words over a `card-img`. A `stretched-link` makes the whole card its link.

```html
<div class="grid md:cols-2 gap-16">
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-images-title">
		<img class="card-img-top ratio-16x9" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="A lagoon under green hills">
		<div class="card-body vstack gap-4">
			<h2 class="fs-16" id="card-images-title"><a class="stretched-link" href="#card-images">Ang Thong by speedboat</a></h2>
			<p class="text-muted mb-0">From 2 500 THB · a day</p>
		</div>
	</section>
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-overlay-title">
		<img class="card-img ratio-16x9" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="">
		<div class="card-img-overlay vstack justify-content-end">
			<h2 class="fs-16" id="card-overlay-title">The emerald lake</h2>
		</div>
	</section>
</div>
```

### Tabs on a card

A `nav` placed straight in the card lines up with the header's padding.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-tabs-title">Ang Thong</h2></div>
	<div class="nav nav-underline" role="tablist" aria-label="Ang Thong">
		<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="card-tabs-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="card-tabs-panel-1">Details</button>
		<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="card-tabs-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="card-tabs-panel-2">Prices</button>
	</div>
	<div class="card-body" id="card-tabs-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-1" tabindex="0"><p>A day at sea: snorkelling at two reefs, lunch on the boat.</p></div>
	<div class="card-body" id="card-tabs-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-2" tabindex="0" hidden><p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900.</p></div>
</section>
```

### A grid of cards
