The parent sets the grid; each card measures itself. Under 576 px of the region the cards stack.

```html
<div class="grid sm:cols-2 gap-16">
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-grid-a"><div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-grid-a">Bookings</h2></div><div class="card-body"><p class="fs-24 fw-600 tabular-nums">128</p><p class="text-muted">this week</p></div></section>
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-grid-b"><div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-grid-b">Revenue</h2></div><div class="card-body"><p class="fs-24 fw-600 tabular-nums">312,400 THB</p><p class="text-muted">this week</p></div></section>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- A card that is a part of the page is a `<section>` with `aria-labelledby` pointing at its heading; a card in a list of cards is an `<article>` or a list item.
- A card has no outer margin: the gap between cards belongs to their parent.
- A card being refreshed in place turns busy with `REDZ.ui.busy(card, promise)` - see [Busy](busy.md).

## Tokens

From [`css/components/card.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/card.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-text-muted`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card-group` | - | review | grid with gap-16 |
| `card-header-pills` | - | review | a nav straight in the card |
| `card-header-tabs` | - | review | a nav straight in the card |
| `card-link` | - | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |
| `card-subtitle` | - | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |
| `card-text` | - | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |
| `card-title` | - | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |

# Accordions

Sections that open one at a time, or each on its own, on the browser's own disclosure - `<details>` and `<summary>`: no script, the keys and the open state built in, and the browser's find in page opens a closed section on a match.

## Examples

Items that share a `name` are one group: opening one closes the one that was open. `open` opens an item from the start.

```html
<div class="accordion">
	<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-basic" open>
		<summary class="accordion-header">What does a day trip include?<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">The transfer from the hotel, the boat, lunch, snorkelling gear and the park fee.</div>
	</details>
	<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-basic">
		<summary class="accordion-header">Can I cancel a booking?<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">Free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; later, half the price is kept.</div>
	</details>
	<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-basic">
		<summary class="accordion-header">Are children welcome?<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">From four years old; under four they travel free.</div>
	</details>
</div>
```

### Each on its own

Without `name` every item opens and closes by itself.

```html
<div class="accordion">
	<details class="accordion-item" open>
		<summary class="accordion-header">Pickup<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">07:30 at the pier, 07:00 from the hotels of Chaweng.</div>
	</details>
	<details class="accordion-item">
		<summary class="accordion-header">What to bring<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">Swimwear, a towel and a sunscreen that spares the reef.</div>
	</details>
</div>
```

### Flush

`accordion-flush` drops the frame and the side padding, for sections inside a card or a drawer.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body">
		<div class="accordion accordion-flush">
			<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-flush" open>
				<summary class="accordion-header">Prices<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
				<div class="accordion-body">Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.</div>
			</details>
			<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-flush">
				<summary class="accordion-header">History<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
				<div class="accordion-body">Edited yesterday by M. K.; published on three sites.</div>
			</details>
		</div>
	</div>
</div>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On a section's header |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens or closes the section; in a group, opening it closes the open one |
| `Tab` | The next header, or the first control inside an open section |

- The header is the `<summary>` itself, which the browser announces as expanded or collapsed. Put no heading inside it: screen readers announce a heading in a summary unevenly. When the sections need a place in the page's outline, a heading goes before the accordion.
- The chevron is decoration, `aria-hidden="true"`; it turns as the section opens.
- A section opens with a short animation only where the browser has `interpolate-size`, and only when the reader allows motion; elsewhere it opens at once.
- From script: `details.open = true`, and the `toggle` event after each change.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/accordion.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/accordion.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accordion-button` | - | remove | the summary is the button; its chevron is <i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon"> |
| `accordion-collapse` | - | remove | the body follows the summary inside the <details> |
| `accordion-header` | `accordion-header` | review | the item's <summary> with the button's words in it; no heading and no button inside |
| `accordion-item` | `accordion-item` | review | a <details>; the items of one group share a name, as data-bs-parent did |
| `data-bs-parent` | `name` | trigger | the same name on every <details> of the group |

# Carousels

A row of slides seen one or a few at a time: tours, photos, reviews. The browser scrolls and snaps the row - a swipe, a wheel, the arrow keys - and the buttons move a slide back or on.

## Examples

`carousel` on the frame, a named region; `carousel-inner` on the row, which takes the focus; `carousel-item` on each slide. Buttons with `command="--prev"` or `"--next"` and `aria-controls` naming the carousel move a slide, round the ends. An empty `carousel-indicators` fills with a button per slide. The slide in place is `aria-current="true"`.

```html
<div class="carousel" id="carousel-basic-tours" role="region" aria-label="Tours">
	<div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" aria-label="Tours">
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="p-24 bg-primary-subtle vstack gap-8"><strong>Ang Thong marine park</strong><span>Kayaks, a lagoon and a viewpoint, a day by speedboat.</span></div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="p-24 bg-success-subtle vstack gap-8"><strong>Koh Tao snorkeling</strong><span>Two bays and a coral garden, lunch on board.</span></div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="p-24 bg-warning-subtle vstack gap-8"><strong>Sunset cruise</strong><span>A catamaran round the south coast at dusk.</span></div></div>
	</div>
	<div class="hstack gap-8 justify-content-between">
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--prev" aria-controls="carousel-basic-tours" aria-label="Previous"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		<div class="carousel-indicators"></div>
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" command="--next" aria-controls="carousel-basic-tours" aria-label="Next"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Several at a time

Three custom properties on the carousel set the row, in the module's own stylesheet: `--redz-carousel-items` slides in view, `--redz-carousel-gap` between them and `--redz-carousel-peek` of the next one at the edges. `carousel-center` snaps a slide to the middle, `carousel-auto` lets each slide keep its own width.

```js
.tour-reviews { --redz-carousel-items: 2; --redz-carousel-gap: 12px; --redz-carousel-peek: 24px; }
```

```html
<div class="carousel" id="carousel-several-reviews" role="region" aria-label="Reviews">
	<div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" aria-label="Reviews">
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="card card-body h-100">“The best day of our trip.” - Anna</div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="card card-body h-100">“Kind guides and a clean boat.” - Mark</div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="card card-body h-100">“The lagoon is worth the climb.” - Somchai</div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="card card-body h-100">“Lunch was a surprise, a good one.” - Leila</div></div>
	</div>
	<div class="hstack gap-8 justify-content-end">
		<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" command="--prev" aria-controls="carousel-several-reviews" aria-label="Previous"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" command="--next" aria-controls="carousel-several-reviews" aria-label="Next"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
</div>
```

### One at a time, fading, playing

`carousel-fade` stacks the slides and shows the current one. `carousel-overlay` lays its buttons over the slides. A button with `command="--play"` plays the slides on every 5 seconds while it is `aria-pressed="true"` - written so, it plays from the start - and pauses while the pointer rests on the carousel or the focus is in it; it never plays for a person who asks for less motion.

```html
<div class="carousel carousel-fade" id="carousel-fade-island" role="region" aria-label="The island">
	<div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" aria-label="The island">
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="p-32 bg-info-subtle text-center"><strong>Beaches</strong></div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="p-32 bg-success-subtle text-center"><strong>Waterfalls</strong></div></div>
		<div class="carousel-item"><div class="p-32 bg-warning-subtle text-center"><strong>Temples</strong></div></div>
	</div>
	<div class="carousel-overlay">
		<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" command="--prev" aria-controls="carousel-fade-island" aria-label="Previous"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm" type="button" command="--next" aria-controls="carousel-fade-island" aria-label="Next"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<div class="hstack gap-8 justify-content-center">
		<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm btn-text" type="button" command="--play" aria-controls="carousel-fade-island" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Play the slides"><i class="bi bi-play-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="bi bi-pause-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
		<div class="carousel-indicators"></div>
	</div>
</div>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The carousel is a named region and each slide a group named by the page's text `slide` - “2 of 5”; an indicator button says the same, the current one `aria-current="true"`.
- The row takes the focus (`tabindex="0"` and a name): the arrow keys scroll it, a slide at a time in a fading carousel.
- A slide a person moves to by a button is told politely in a status of the carousel; nothing is told while it plays.
- The play button is a toggle button, pressed while it plays; the pointer resting on the carousel, the focus inside it and a hidden page pause it (WCAG 2.2.2).
- The buttons have no `commandfor`, which WebKit would announce as collapsed; their icons mirror right to left. An indicator is a 24 px target round its dot.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/carousel.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/carousel.css). It declares `--redz-carousel-items`, `--redz-carousel-gap`, `--redz-carousel-peek` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `carousel-caption` | - | review | the slide's own text, laid out with utilities |
| `carousel-control-next` | - | review | a btn btn-icon with command="--next" and aria-controls naming the carousel |
| `carousel-control-next-icon` | `bi bi-chevron-right` | rename | mirrored right to left |
| `carousel-control-prev` | - | review | a btn btn-icon with command="--prev" and aria-controls naming the carousel |
| `carousel-control-prev-icon` | `bi bi-chevron-left` | rename | mirrored right to left |
| `carousel-dark` | - | review | data-theme="dark" on the carousel |
| `carousel-item-end` | - | remove | the browser scrolls the row |
| `carousel-item-next` | - | remove | the browser scrolls the row |
| `carousel-item-prev` | - | remove | the browser scrolls the row |
| `carousel-item-start` | - | remove | the browser scrolls the row |
| `data-bs-slide="prev"` | `command="--prev" aria-controls="ID"` | trigger | the id of the carousel, without commandfor |
| `data-bs-slide="next"` | `command="--next" aria-controls="ID"` | trigger | the id of the carousel, without commandfor |
| `data-bs-slide-to` | - | remove | an empty carousel-indicators makes its buttons |
| `data-bs-ride` | `command="--play" aria-pressed="true"` | review | a play button pressed from the start, which a person who asks for less motion never sees play |
| `data-bs-interval` | - | remove | slides turn every 5 seconds |
| `bootstrap.Carousel` | `the --prev and --next buttons` | review | or scrollBy on carousel-inner; the row scrolls by the browser |

# Collapse

A button that opens and closes a region elsewhere on the page - help under a toolbar, more filters, the details of a row - by the library's own command, `--toggle`. A closed region is `hidden="until-found"`, so the browser's find in page still reaches its words and opens it. A section that opens under its own header is an [accordion](accordion.md).

## Examples

The button carries `command="--toggle"`, names its region in `aria-controls` and says in `aria-expanded` whether the region is open: write it as the region starts, and the library keeps it. It takes no `commandfor`: WebKit would then tell a screen reader the button is collapsed whatever its `aria-expanded` says.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-help-text" aria-expanded="false"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>How prices work</button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-help-text" hidden="until-found">
	<p class="text-muted">A price is per person. Children from four to eleven pay the child price; under four they travel free.</p>
</div>
```

### Open from the start

A region without `hidden` starts open, its button `aria-expanded="true"`.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-open-filters" aria-expanded="true"><i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>More filters</button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-open-filters" class="hstack flex-wrap gap-8">
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">With lunch</button>
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Private</button>
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Sunset</button>
</div>
```

### A details row in a table

A row under a row opens and closes the same way: the region is a `<tr>` with one cell across the table. A table's row cannot be hidden "until found", so it starts as plain `hidden` and closes so again; find in page does not open it.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Deleted records">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">When</th><th scope="col">What</th><th scope="col"><span class="visually-hidden">Details</span></th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr>
			<td class="tabular-nums">12:40</td>
			<td>3 excursions</td>
			<td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-text" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-row-details" aria-expanded="false">Details</button></td>
		</tr>
		<tr id="collapse-row-details" hidden>
			<td colspan="3">Ang Thong, Koh Tao and the sunset cruise, with their photos and reviews.</td>
		</tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the button |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens or closes the region; every button for it says the new state |

- Find in page opens a closed region on a match where the browser has `hidden="until-found"` - Chrome, Firefox 148 and Safari 26.2 on - and the library marks its buttons open; in older browsers the region stays closed until its button opens it.
- Put the region right after its button in the reading order, or name it, so a reader who opens it finds it.
- From script: `region.hidden = false` opens it - set `aria-expanded` on its buttons yourself then.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse` | - | state | closed: hidden="until-found" on the region; open: no hidden; its button has command="--toggle" |
| `collapse-horizontal` | - | review | not planned: a region opens downward, in its place |
| `collapsing` | - | remove | the region opens at once |
| `data-bs-toggle="collapse"` | `command="--toggle" aria-controls="ID" aria-expanded="false"` | trigger | the region is hidden="until-found" while closed; in an accordion the item is a <details> |
| `bootstrap.Collapse` | `region.hidden = false` | review | and setAttribute('hidden', 'until-found') to close; set aria-expanded on its buttons then: a button with command="--toggle" does both |

# List groups

A column of items in one frame - plain rows, or links and buttons to choose from - with the current one and the unavailable ones marked by the same attributes the browser reads.

## Examples

`list-group` on a list, `list-group-item` on each item.

```html
<ul class="list-group">
	<li class="list-group-item">Ang Thong Marine Park</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">The Five Islands by kayak</li>
</ul>
```

### Links and buttons

`list-group-item-action` makes an item a choice. The current one is `aria-current` - `"page"` for a link to the page shown, `"true"` otherwise; one that cannot be chosen is a `disabled` button, or a link without `href` and with `aria-disabled="true"`.

```html
<nav class="list-group" aria-label="Sites">
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#list-group-action" aria-current="page">All sites</a>
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#list-group-action">lagoon.example</a>
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#list-group-action">angthong.example</a>
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" aria-disabled="true">archive.example</a>
</nav>
<div class="list-group" role="group" aria-label="Import from">
	<button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" type="button">A CSV file</button>
	<button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" type="button">Another site</button>
	<button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" type="button" disabled>The old catalog</button>
</div>
```

### Flush, numbered, with counts

`list-group-flush` drops the frame, for a list inside a card; `list-group-numbered` on an `<ol>` numbers the items.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body">
		<ol class="list-group list-group-flush list-group-numbered">
			<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><span class="flex-fill">Ang Thong Marine Park</span><span class="badge">28</span></li>
			<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><span class="flex-fill">Koh Tao</span><span class="badge">11</span></li>
			<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><span class="flex-fill">The Five Islands</span><span class="badge badge-subtle-warning">3</span></li>
		</ol>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Side by side

`list-group-horizontal` sets the items in a row; with a width prefix, from that width of the region on: `md:list-group-horizontal`.

```html
<ul class="list-group md:list-group-horizontal">
	<li class="list-group-item">Transfer</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Boat</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Lunch</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Park fee</li>
</ul>
```

### With checks

```html
<div class="list-group" role="group" aria-label="Show on">
	<label class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>lagoon.example</label>
	<label class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>angthong.example</label>
	<label class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><input class="check" type="checkbox">kohtao.example</label>
</div>
```

### Reordering

A list with `data-reorder` naming a hidden field moves its items, each with a `data-value`, by a `drag-handle`: a button opening the list's menu of moves, whose items carry `data-move` - `up`, `down`, `first`, `last` - or the pointer dragging the handle. A move is done at once, the focus back on the handle, and the page's text `moved` says the new place. Then `redz:move` fires on the item: a page that saves cancels it and answers with a promise - refused, the move is undone and the page's words are said; left alone, hidden fields beside the list hold the new order for the form.

```html
<ul class="list-group" id="list-group-moves-list" aria-label="Stops of the tour" data-reorder="stops[]">
	<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8" data-value="pier"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: The pier"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>The pier</li>
	<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8" data-value="lagoon"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: The emerald lake"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>The emerald lake</li>
	<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8" data-value="beach"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Lunch on the beach"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>Lunch on the beach</li>
</ul>
<div class="menu" id="list-group-moves-menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Move">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="up"><i class="bi bi-arrow-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move up</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="down"><i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move down</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="first">Move to the top</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="last">Move to the bottom</button>
</div>
```

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:move', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	const {item, parent, position} = event.detail;
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch('/stops/' + item.dataset.value + '/place', {method: 'POST', body: new URLSearchParams({parent: parent?.dataset.value ?? '', position})})
		.then((answer) => answer.ok || Promise.reject('The stop could not be moved')));
});
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Links and buttons keep their own keys: `Tab` from one to the next, `Enter` - and `Space` on a button - to choose. A list of links that moves between pages is a `<nav>` with its own name.
- The current item is `aria-current`, never a class: the screen reader says “current page”, the look follows the attribute.
- A link that may not be followed has no `href`: `aria-disabled` alone would leave it working.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/list-group.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/list-group.css). It declares `--redz-list-group-row`, `--redz-list-group-column` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-text-muted`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list-group-item-danger` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-dark` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-info` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-light` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-primary` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-secondary` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-success` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |
| `list-group-item-warning` | - | review | no item tones: a badge or a dot in the item says it |

# Trees

Pages under pages, a menu's items, folders: a list whose items open their own lists, each a link or a name, and moved by a handle.

## Examples

`tree` on the list, `tree-item` on each item, its `tree-row` holding a `tree-toggle` - a `--toggle` button naming the item's `tree-group` in `aria-controls`, as on [collapse](collapse.md) - and the item's link. The groups close as `hidden="until-found"`, so the browser's find in page still opens them. A button with `command="--expand-all"` or `"--collapse-all"` for the tree opens or closes every group that holds items.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="tree-pages-list" command="--expand-all"><i class="bi bi-arrows-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>Expand all</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="tree-pages-list" command="--collapse-all"><i class="bi bi-arrows-collapse" aria-hidden="true"></i>Collapse all</button>
</div>
<ul class="tree" id="tree-pages-list" aria-label="Pages">
	<li class="tree-item">
		<div class="tree-row">
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text tree-toggle" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="tree-pages-excursions" aria-expanded="true" aria-label="Excursions"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<a href="#tree-pages">Excursions</a>
		</div>
		<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-pages-excursions">
			<li class="tree-item"><div class="tree-row"><a href="#tree-pages">Ang Thong by speedboat</a></div></li>
			<li class="tree-item"><div class="tree-row"><a href="#tree-pages">Night market and street food</a></div></li>
		</ul>
	</li>
	<li class="tree-item">
		<div class="tree-row">
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text tree-toggle" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="tree-pages-islands" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Islands"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<a href="#tree-pages">Islands</a>
		</div>
		<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-pages-islands" hidden="until-found">
			<li class="tree-item"><div class="tree-row"><a href="#tree-pages">Koh Tao</a></div></li>
			<li class="tree-item"><div class="tree-row"><a href="#tree-pages">Koh Phangan</a></div></li>
		</ul>
	</li>
	<li class="tree-item">
		<div class="tree-row">
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text tree-toggle" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="tree-pages-archive" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Archive"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<a href="#tree-pages">Archive</a>
		</div>
		<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-pages-archive" hidden="until-found" data-lazy data-docs-lazy></ul>
	</li>
	<li class="tree-item"><div class="tree-row"><a href="#tree-pages">Contacts</a></div></li>
</ul>
```

### Children from the server

A group with `data-lazy` and no items fires `redz:expand` on it when it first opens. A page that loads the items cancels it and answers with a promise: the toggle is busy until it settles, and a refusal closes the group again for another try. The Archive above answers after 400 ms.

```js
document.addEventListener('redz:expand', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch('/pages?parent=' + event.target.dataset.parent)
		.then((answer) => answer.text())
		.then((items) => event.target.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', items)));
});
```

### Moved by a handle

A tree with `data-reorder` moves its items as a list does - see [reordering](list-group.md#list-group-reorder) - and its menu of moves adds `data-move="in"`, to the end of the group of the item above, and `"out"`, after its parent; an item can go in where the item above has a `tree-group`, empty or not. `data-parent` names the hidden field of each item's parent, its value the item's key.

```html
<ul class="tree" id="tree-menu-list" aria-label="The site's menu" data-reorder="menu[]" data-parent="menu_parent">
	<li class="tree-item" data-value="home">
		<div class="tree-row">
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="tree-menu-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Home"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<span>Home</span>
		</div>
		<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-menu-home"></ul>
	</li>
	<li class="tree-item" data-value="tours">
		<div class="tree-row">
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="tree-menu-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Tours"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<span>Tours</span>
		</div>
		<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-menu-tours">
			<li class="tree-item" data-value="boats">
				<div class="tree-row">
					<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="tree-menu-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Boats"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
					<span>Boats</span>
				</div>
				<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-menu-boats"></ul>
			</li>
		</ul>
	</li>
	<li class="tree-item" data-value="contacts">
		<div class="tree-row">
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="tree-menu-moves" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Contacts"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			<span>Contacts</span>
		</div>
		<ul class="tree-group" id="tree-menu-contacts"></ul>
	</li>
</ul>
<div class="menu" id="tree-menu-moves" popover role="menu" aria-label="Move">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="up"><i class="bi bi-arrow-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move up</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="down"><i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move down</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="in"><i class="bi bi-arrow-return-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move into the item above</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="out"><i class="bi bi-arrow-bar-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move out</button>
</div>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The tree is a list of lists with buttons and links - the disclosure pattern: Tab goes from one control to the next, `Enter` or `Space` opens or closes a group, and the toggle says it in `aria-expanded`. It is not the ARIA tree widget, which the APG itself keeps for choosing, not for links.
- A toggle is named after its item; its chevron points along the line of reading, mirrored right to left.
- The moves are a menu on the handle, so a keyboard, a screen reader and a single tap move an item as a drag does; after a move the focus stays on the moved item's handle and its new place is said politely.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/tree.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/tree.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

# Tables

A list of records: a title that links to the record, a line under it, a note when something is wrong, a column of checks for batch actions and the row's own actions at the end.

## Examples

`table` on the `<table>`; `table-hover` lights the row under the pointer. The head stays at the top of the screen as the page scrolls. Columns that only help on a wide screen hide below `md` of their card.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-list-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 id="table-list-title">Excursions</h2><span class="text-muted fs-12">3 of 28</span></div>
	<div class="card-body p-0">
		<table class="table table-hover">
			<thead>
				<tr>
					<th class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select all"></th>
					<th>Excursion</th>
					<th class="text-end d-none md:d-table-cell">Price from</th>
					<th class="d-none md:d-table-cell">Status</th>
					<th class="table-actions"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th>
				</tr>
			</thead>
			<tbody>
				<tr>
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Ang Thong"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Ang Thong: marine park by speedboat</a><div class="table-sub d-none md:d-block">/excursions/ang-thong/</div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">2,500 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-check2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Ang Thong"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-danger">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Elephant sanctuary"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Elephant sanctuary: feeding and a walk</a><div class="table-note"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="text-muted">Did not rebuild: a PHP warning in the theme template</span></div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">2,600 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge badge-subtle-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i>Failed</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Rebuild: Elephant sanctuary"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-warning">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Night market"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Night market and street food</a><div class="table-note"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="text-muted">The Thai translation is older than the English</span></div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">900 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Night market"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-secondary">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Muay Thai"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Muay Thai: an evening at the stadium</a><div class="table-sub d-none md:d-block">withdrawn from the sites</div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">1,500 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-eye-slash" aria-hidden="true"></i>Withdrawn</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Muay Thai"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Stripes, borders and groups

`table-striped` shades every other row, `table-striped-columns` every other column - under the hover's light and a row's tone alike; `table-group-divider` on a `tbody` draws a stronger line above it. `table-bordered` draws the lines between columns and, outside a card, the table's own frame; `table-borderless` takes the lines between rows away.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-variants-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 class="fs-14" id="table-variants-title">Boats this week</h2></div>
	<table class="table table-striped table-hover">
		<thead><tr><th scope="col">Boat</th><th class="text-end" scope="col">Trips</th><th class="text-end" scope="col">Seats sold</th></tr></thead>
		<tbody>
			<tr><td>Sea Breeze</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">12</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">286</td></tr>
			<tr><td>Coral Star</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">9</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">201</td></tr>
			<tr><td>Blue Lagoon</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">7</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">164</td></tr>
		</tbody>
		<tbody class="table-group-divider">
			<tr><td>All boats</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">28</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">651</td></tr>
		</tbody>
	</table>
</section>
<table class="table table-bordered" aria-label="Seasons on Samui">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Season</th><th scope="col">Months</th><th scope="col">The sea</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Dry</td><td>January to April</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Hot</td><td>May to August</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Rainy</td><td>September to December</td><td>Waves</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

### Compact rows

`data-density="compact"` tightens the rows and the controls of the element it is on and of everything inside it: a table, the card that holds it, a region, or the whole page on `<html>`. A compact table can stand beside a normal one on the same screen. Bootstrap 5 calls it `table-sm`.

```html
<table class="table table-bordered" data-density="compact" aria-label="Seasons on Samui, compact">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">Season</th><th scope="col">Months</th><th scope="col">The sea</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr><td>Dry</td><td>January to April</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Hot</td><td>May to August</td><td>Calm</td></tr>
		<tr><td>Rainy</td><td>September to December</td><td>Waves</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

## States

A row's tone marks what needs attention: `table-danger` failed, `table-warning` needs a look, `table-secondary` is out of use. On a pointer screen the row's actions show on hover and on focus; on a touch screen they always show.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The row's title is a link; its actions are buttons named with the record - "Edit: Ang Thong", not a column of identical "Edit".
- The column of actions has a hidden header, and each check its own name: "Select: Ang Thong".
- A tone is never the only sign: a failed row also says why in its `table-note`, with an icon.
- Numbers sit at the end of their cells with `tabular-nums`, so their digits line up.
- A table being reloaded turns busy on its card's body: `REDZ.ui.busy(body, promise)` - not on the `<table>`, which cannot hold an overlay.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/table.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/table.css). It declares `--redz-row-tint`, `--redz-row-mark` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-row-pad`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-font-mono`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-bg-page`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption-top` | - | missing |  |
| `table-active` | - | review | aria-selected or aria-current on the row |
| `table-dark` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-info` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-light` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-primary` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-responsive` | - | review | the card's body holds the table; columns hide below md: |
| `table-success` | - | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |

# Badges

A badge is a short label of state or count beside the thing it describes: Published, Draft, 5 new. It never acts - a badge that does something is a chip or a button.

## Examples

The plain `badge` is neutral, for a status that needs no attention. `badge-subtle-{tone}` is the usual colored form; `badge-{tone}`, filled, is for the one that must be seen. An icon before the words carries the meaning in forced colors and for people who do not tell the colors apart.

```html
<span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-check2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</span>
<span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i>Draft</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Paid</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i>Failed</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-info"><i class="bi bi-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i>Machine translation</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">New</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-secondary">Archived</span>
```

### Filled

```html
<span class="badge badge-primary">5</span>
<span class="badge badge-secondary">Beta</span>
<span class="badge badge-success">Live</span>
<span class="badge badge-danger">Overdue</span>
<span class="badge badge-warning">Due today</span>
<span class="badge badge-info">Update</span>
```

`badge-inverse` is the text color with the page color on it - dark in the light theme, light in the dark one - for a mark that must stand apart from every tone: a whole company wiped beside rows deleted for good and rows moved to the bin.

```html
<span class="badge badge-danger">Deleted</span>
<span class="badge badge-warning">In the bin</span>
<span class="badge badge-inverse">Company wiped</span>
```

### Beside other things

A count in a navigation link, a status in a heading.

```html
<nav class="nav nav-pills" aria-label="Orders">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#badge-beside" aria-current="page">New<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">5</span></a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#badge-beside">Paid<span class="badge">128</span></a>
</nav>
<h3 class="hstack gap-8 fs-16">Ang Thong <span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span></h3>
```

## Accessibility

- A badge's words are read with the thing it stands beside; write them so - "5" in "New 5" reads as five new orders only if the link says New.
- The tones of text against their fill are at least 4.5:1 in both themes; a tone alone is never the meaning.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/badge.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/badge.css). It declares `--redz-badge-bg`, `--redz-badge-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-secondary-contrast`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-success-contrast`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-danger-contrast`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-warning-contrast`, `--redz-info`, `--redz-info-contrast`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-info-subtle`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-bg-danger` | `badge-danger` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-danger with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-dark` | `badge-inverse` | review | on a badge: the text color as its background, light in the dark theme |
| `text-bg-info` | `badge-info` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-info with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-light` | - | review | a plain badge, or a tone |
| `text-bg-primary` | `badge-primary` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-primary with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-secondary` | `badge-secondary` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-secondary with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-success` | `badge-success` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-success with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-warning` | `badge-warning` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-warning with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |

# Dots

An 8 px dot of a tone beside a word: online, live, the color of a site. The dot repeats what the word says; it never says it alone.

## Examples

```html
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot"></span>Offline</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-primary"></span>Primary</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-secondary"></span>Secondary</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-success"></span>Live</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-danger"></span>Down</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-warning"></span>Slow</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-info"></span>Updating</span>
```

## Accessibility

- A dot has no name; the word beside it carries the meaning. In forced colors every dot is drawn in the text color, so the word is what tells them apart.
- Dots print with their colors.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/dot.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/dot.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-info`.

# Avatars

A round mark of a person: their initials in the accent, 32 px or 24 px with `avatar-sm`.

## Examples

An avatar beside the person's name hides from assistive technology; an avatar alone - the profile button - is named by its button.

```html
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">MK</span>Marina K.</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="avatar avatar-sm" aria-hidden="true">AT</span>Arthit T.</span>
<button class="btn btn-text btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="MK, profile"><span class="avatar">MK</span></button>
```

## Accessibility

- The initials are 4.5:1 against the fill in both themes.
- Where a person's photo is wanted, put an `<img alt="">` inside the avatar; the name beside it carries the meaning.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/avatar.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/avatar.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-fs-12`.

# Icon tiles

A rounded square with an icon in it: the mark of a screen's subject in its title, of a kind of record, of a drop zone.

## Examples

The plain tile is in the accent; the tones and `icon-tile-sm` follow Bootstrap's grammar.

```html
<span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-compass" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-secondary"><i class="bi bi-archive" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-warning"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-info"><i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-sm"><i class="bi bi-upload" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
```

### In a title

```html
<div class="hstack gap-12">
	<span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-compass" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
	<div><h3 class="fs-20">Excursions</h3><p class="text-muted">Content type · 28 items</p></div>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- The tile is decoration: its icon is `aria-hidden="true"` and the words beside it name the subject.
- The icon keeps a 3:1 contrast with its tile in both themes.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/icon-tile.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/icon-tile.css). It declares `--redz-tile-bg`, `--redz-tile-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-info-subtle`, `--redz-info`.

# Empty states

What a list, a panel or a search shows when it has nothing yet: what would be here, and the one action that starts it. And the drop zone of a file field.

## Examples

```html
<div class="empty-state">
	<i class="bi bi-compass" aria-hidden="true"></i>
	<strong class="text-body">No excursions yet</strong>
	<p>An excursion is a page with a price, a schedule and a booking form.</p>
	<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>New excursion</button>
</div>
```

### A drop zone

`empty-state-drop` is a label around a hidden file input: a click or a dropped file goes to the input.

```html
<label class="empty-state empty-state-drop">
	<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-sm"><i class="bi bi-upload" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
	<span class="vstack gap-2"><strong class="text-body">Logo · light theme</strong><span class="form-text">SVG or PNG, drop a file or choose</span></span>
	<input class="visually-hidden" type="file" accept="image/svg+xml,image/png">
</label>
```

## States

## Accessibility

- Say what would be here and why it is empty - "No excursions yet", "Nothing matches the filters" - and offer the action that changes it.
- The drop zone's file input is hidden visually only; its label is the zone's words, and the focus ring shows on the zone through the label.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/empty-state.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/empty-state.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-32`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-subtle`.

# Placeholders

Grey bars in the shape of content that is on its way - the first load of a page or a panel. A region that already has content and reloads it gets an overlay instead: see [Busy](busy.md).

## Examples

Each bar is a `placeholder` sized by a width utility. They pulse slowly, and stand still for people who ask for less motion.

```html
<section class="card" aria-label="Loading">
	<div class="card-header"><span class="placeholder w-25"></span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<span class="placeholder w-75"></span>
		<span class="placeholder w-50"></span>
		<span class="placeholder w-100"></span>
	</div>
</section>
```

## Accessibility

- Placeholders are empty elements; the region holding them is named "Loading" until the content takes its place.
- Keep the shapes close to the real content, so the page does not jump when it arrives.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/placeholder.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/placeholder.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-border`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder-glow` | - | remove | placeholders pulse by themselves |
| `placeholder-wave` | - | remove | placeholders pulse by themselves |
| `placeholder-xs` | - | review | size by the height of the bar |

# Prose

Long text that comes from an editor or from Markdown, where no element carries a class: a page's content in a preview, a help page, a note. One class on the wrapper sets the size, the rhythm and the measure of everything inside.

## Examples

`prose` on the element that holds the text. Headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, rules, images and tables inside it take sizes for reading, a space between blocks and a line no longer than about 72 characters; the interface around it keeps its own smaller type.

```html
<article class="prose">
	<h2>A day at Ang Thong</h2>
	<p>The boat leaves the pier at eight and is back before sunset. Lunch is on the beach, and the water is calm from December to April.</p>
	<h3>What to bring</h3>
	<ul>
		<li>Shoes for the climb to the lookout</li>
		<li>A hat and water</li>
		<li>Cash for the park fee</li>
	</ul>
	<blockquote>
		<p>The emerald lake is a short walk from the beach.</p>
	</blockquote>
	<p>The booking code is <code>ANG-0812</code>; show it at the pier.</p>
</article>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Prose styles the elements the text already has: its headings stay headings, so a screen reader walks them as it walks any page. Start the text's headings below the page's own: a `prose` inside a page with an `<h1>` starts at `<h2>`.
- The measure keeps lines short enough to read; the text still wraps at any width, and a long word breaks rather than widening the page.
- Links are underlined in the text, so they are not told apart by colour alone.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/prose.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/prose.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-fs-32`, `--redz-fs-24`, `--redz-fs-20`, `--redz-fs-18`, `--redz-link`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-radius-4`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-fs-14`, `--redz-space-8`.

# Dialogs

The browser's own modal `<dialog>`: opened by a command, the page behind it inert and dimmed, closed by its buttons, `Esc` or a click outside. And `REDZ.ui.confirm()` for a question asked from script.

## Examples

A button opens the dialog with `commandfor` + `command="show-modal"`; buttons inside close it with `command="close"`. `closedby="any"` lets a click outside close it too. The focus goes into the dialog - to the control marked `autofocus` - and back to the button when it closes.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-chat-left-text" aria-hidden="true"></i>Add a note</button>
<dialog id="dialog-edit-note" class="dialog" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="dialog-edit-note-title">
	<div class="dialog-header">
		<h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-edit-note-title">A note for the guides</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-body vstack gap-8">
		<label class="form-field"><span class="form-label">Note</span><textarea class="form-control" autofocus>Pick up at the pier at 8:30.</textarea></label>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-footer">
		<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="close">Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="close">Save</button>
	</div>
</dialog>
```

### Sizes

`dialog-sm` for a question, the default for a form, `dialog-lg` for a wide table or a preview.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-sm" command="show-modal">Small</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-lg" command="show-modal">Large</button>
<dialog id="dialog-sizes-sm" class="dialog dialog-sm" aria-labelledby="dialog-sizes-sm-title">
	<div class="dialog-header"><h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-sizes-sm-title">Publish now?</h2></div>
	<div class="dialog-body"><p>The page goes live on three sites.</p></div>
	<div class="dialog-footer">
		<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-sm" command="close" autofocus>Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-sm" command="close">Publish</button>
	</div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="dialog-sizes-lg" class="dialog dialog-lg" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="dialog-sizes-lg-title">
	<div class="dialog-header">
		<h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-sizes-lg-title">History of changes</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-lg" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-body"><p>Edited yesterday by M. K.; published on three sites; the Thai translation updated today.</p></div>
</dialog>
```

### A confirmation from script

`await REDZ.ui.confirm({title, text, ok, tone})` builds an `alertdialog`, waits for the answer and removes it: `true` for the confirming button, `false` for Cancel, `Esc` or a click outside. The focus starts on Cancel; the button words come from the caller or the page's texts.

```html
<button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-docs-run="confirm"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Delete 2 excursions</button>
<span class="text-muted fs-12" role="status" data-docs-answer></span>
```

For what cannot be undone, `phrase` asks the person to type a word first - the site's name, say: a field under the text, labelled by the page's text `confirm.phrase`, takes the focus, the confirming button waits until the words match, and `Enter` in the field confirms then.

```html
<button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-docs-run="confirm-phrase"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Delete the site</button>
<span class="text-muted fs-12" role="status" data-docs-answer></span>
```

### On a phone and full screen

On a window narrower than 576 px a dialog fills the screen by itself - its body scrolls, its footer stays at the bottom - while `dialog-sm` and a confirmation stay a card in the middle. `dialog-fullscreen` fills the screen on any window.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-full-panel" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-arrows-fullscreen" aria-hidden="true"></i>Open full screen</button>
<dialog class="dialog dialog-fullscreen" id="dialog-full-panel" aria-labelledby="dialog-full-title">
	<div class="dialog-header">
		<h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-full-title">Route of the day</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="dialog-full-panel" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-body"><p>Pick-up at the hotel at 7:30, the pier at 8:15, Ang Thong at 9:30; snorkeling, the emerald lake, lunch on the boat, back by 17:00.</p></div>
	<div class="dialog-footer"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="dialog-full-panel" command="close">Done</button></div>
</dialog>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- `Tab` stays inside an open dialog; `Esc` closes it; the focus goes back to the button that opened it.
- The dialog is named by its title through `aria-labelledby`. A question that must be answered is `role="alertdialog"` with its focus on the safe answer.
- The page behind does not scroll while a dialog is open, and keeps its width: the scrollbar's place stays.
- A notice raised while a dialog is open shows inside the dialog, since everything outside it is inert.
- Where the browser lacks invoker commands (below Chrome 135, Firefox 144, Safari 26.2) or `closedby` (below Chrome 134, Firefox 141, and in Safari), the library's script stands in.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/dialog.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/dialog.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-16`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-3`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-24`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modal` | `dialog` | rename | on a <dialog>, opened by commandfor + command="show-modal" |
| `modal-backdrop` | - | remove | the browser's ::backdrop |
| `modal-body` | `dialog-body` | rename |  |
| `modal-content` | - | remove | no wrappers: the <dialog> is the box |
| `modal-dialog` | - | remove | no wrappers: the <dialog> is the box |
| `modal-dialog-centered` | - | remove | a dialog is centered |
| `modal-dialog-scrollable` | - | remove | the dialog's body scrolls by itself |
| `modal-footer` | `dialog-footer` | rename |  |
| `modal-fullscreen` | `dialog-fullscreen` | rename |  |
| `modal-header` | `dialog-header` | rename |  |
| `modal-static` | - | remove | closedby="closerequest" |
| `modal-title` | `dialog-title` | rename |  |
| `data-bs-toggle="modal"` | `commandfor="ID" command="show-modal"` | trigger | on the button; the dialog is a <dialog id="ID"> |
| `data-bs-dismiss="modal"` | `commandfor="ID" command="close"` | trigger |  |
| `data-bs-backdrop="static"` | `closedby="closerequest"` | trigger | Esc closes it, a click outside does not |
| `data-bs-keyboard="false"` | `closedby="none"` | trigger | only its buttons close it |
| `bootstrap.Modal` | `dialog.showModal() and dialog.close()` | trigger |  |
| `show.bs.modal` | `toggle` | review | the dialog's toggle event, or code right after showModal() |
| `shown.bs.modal` | `toggle` | review | the dialog's toggle event, or code right after showModal() |
| `hide.bs.modal` | `cancel` | review | the dialog's cancel event (Esc); your buttons close it |
| `hidden.bs.modal` | `close` | rename | the dialog's close event; dialog.returnValue holds the closing button's value |

# Drawers

A modal panel at the end of the screen - or at its start with `drawer-start` - for filters, a record's details, a long form beside the list it belongs to. Bootstrap 5 calls it offcanvas; it is a `<dialog>` here.

## Examples

A drawer opens and closes like a dialog: `command="show-modal"` and `command="close"`. It slides in from its side - mirrored right to left - unless the person asks for less motion.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>Filters</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-start" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-layout-sidebar" aria-hidden="true"></i>From the start</button>
<dialog id="drawer-filters-panel" class="drawer" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-filters-panel-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-filters-panel-title">Filters</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body vstack gap-16">
		<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
			<legend class="form-label">Status</legend>
			<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Published</label>
			<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox">Draft</label>
		</fieldset>
		<div class="form-floating">
			<select class="form-select" id="drawer-filters-section"><option>Any section</option><option>Marine</option><option>Land</option></select>
			<label for="drawer-filters-section">Section</label>
		</div>
		<div class="hstack gap-8 justify-content-end">
			<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close">Reset</button>
			<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close">Show 9</button>
		</div>
	</div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="drawer-filters-start" class="drawer drawer-start" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-filters-start-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-filters-start-title">Sections</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-start" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body"><p>A drawer at the start edge: the left in English, the right in Arabic.</p></div>
</dialog>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Everything said of [dialogs](dialog.md) holds: the focus moves in and back, `Tab` stays inside, `Esc` closes.
- A drawer is a region: the width prefixes inside it measure the drawer, 28 rem wide at most.
- The drawer's body scrolls by itself; its header stays.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/drawer.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/drawer.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-3`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offcanvas` | `drawer` | rename | on a <dialog>, opened by command="show-modal" |
| `offcanvas-backdrop` | - | remove | the browser's ::backdrop |
| `offcanvas-body` | `drawer-body` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-bottom` | - | missing |  |
| `offcanvas-end` | `drawer` | rename | on a <dialog>, opened by command="show-modal" |
| `offcanvas-header` | `drawer-header` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-start` | `drawer drawer-start` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-title` | `drawer-title` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-top` | - | missing |  |
| `data-bs-toggle="offcanvas"` | `commandfor="ID" command="show-modal"` | trigger | the drawer is a <dialog id="ID"> |
| `data-bs-dismiss="offcanvas"` | `commandfor="ID" command="close"` | trigger |  |
| `bootstrap.Offcanvas` | `dialog.showModal() and dialog.close()` | trigger |  |

# Popovers

A small panel that opens beside its button and holds more than a label: a title, a few lines of text, a link. A click outside or `Esc` closes it; the page under it stays usable.

## Examples

`popover` on the panel, `popover-header` on its title, `popover-body` on its text. The button opens it with `commandfor` and `command="toggle-popover"`; the panel stands below the button, its start edge on the button's, and turns above or across where there is no room.

```html
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" commandfor="popover-titled-panel" command="toggle-popover">Park fee</button>
<div id="popover-titled-panel" class="popover" popover role="dialog" aria-labelledby="popover-titled-title">
	<div class="popover-header" id="popover-titled-title">Ang Thong marine park</div>
	<div class="popover-body">The fee is paid in cash at the pier and is not part of the tour price. <a href="#popover-titled">The park rules</a></div>
</div>
```

### Only a body

Without a title the panel is its text alone.

```html
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" commandfor="popover-body-panel" command="toggle-popover">Pickup time</button>
<div id="popover-body-panel" class="popover" popover>
	<div class="popover-body">The driver comes 15 minutes before the time on the voucher.</div>
</div>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The panel comes right after its button in the page, so a screen reader reads it there and `Tab` from the button moves into it. Opening it moves no focus; `Esc` closes it and brings focus back to the button.
- The button says whether the panel is open: the browsers set `aria-expanded` for a button with `commandfor`, and `js/commands.js` sets it in Firefox, which does not.
- A panel with a title and a link or a field in it is `role="dialog"`, named by its title in `aria-labelledby`. A panel of words only has no role.
- Nothing that must be read to use the screen lives only in a popover; a choice that needs an answer is a [dialog](dialog.md).
- `js/menu-place.js` keeps the panel beside its button where an engine cannot anchor it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/popover.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/popover.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-2`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-14`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-text-muted`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bs-popover-auto` | - | remove | no arrow: anchor positioning places and flips the panel |
| `bs-popover-bottom` | - | remove | no arrow: anchor positioning places and flips the panel |
| `bs-popover-end` | - | remove | no arrow: anchor positioning places and flips the panel |
| `bs-popover-start` | - | remove | no arrow: anchor positioning places and flips the panel |
| `bs-popover-top` | - | remove | no arrow: anchor positioning places and flips the panel |
| `popover-arrow` | - | remove | no arrow: anchor positioning places and flips the panel |
| `data-bs-toggle="popover"` | `commandfor="ID" command="toggle-popover"` | trigger | the panel is a <div id="ID" class="popover" popover> right after the button |
| `bootstrap.Popover` | `panel.showPopover(), panel.hidePopover(), panel.togglePopover()` | trigger |  |

# Tooltips

A short dark label beside a control. A small button opens it as a toggletip, which a click outside or `Esc` closes; or an element's own title shows it on hover and focus.

## Examples

The tooltip is a `popover` opened by its button's command. It sits above the button and turns below when there is no room - `js/menu-place.js` keeps it beside its button where an engine cannot.

```html
<span class="hstack gap-4">Partner license
	<button class="btn btn-icon btn-xs btn-text" type="button" commandfor="tooltip-why-tip" command="toggle-popover" aria-label="What is a partner license" aria-describedby="tooltip-why-tip"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</span>
<div id="tooltip-why-tip" class="tooltip" popover role="tooltip">A partner can hide the brand and set their own help link.</div>
```

### From a title

Inside an element with `data-tooltips` - `<html>` for the whole page - an element's own `title` shows as this tooltip: after a short hover by a mouse, at once when the keyboard's focus lands on it. It says why a control cannot run, what an icon button does, what a dot stands for. No markup but the title.

```html
<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" title="Duplicate"><i class="bi bi-copy" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn" type="button" aria-disabled="true" title="Publish needs a price for every season">Publish</button>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-warning" title="2 translations are outdated"></span>Ang Thong</span>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The button is named after its question; the tooltip's words answer it. Nothing that must be read to use the screen lives only in a tooltip.
- The button names its tooltip in `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader says the answer with the question, closed or open - opening a popover says nothing of its words.
- A tooltip from a title is the title itself to a screen reader: the element keeps its title on focus, and the tooltip is hidden from assistive technology. While a mouse rests on the element the title is held back, so the browser does not show its own as well; an icon button named only by its title keeps that name meanwhile.
- It stays while the pointer rests on it, hides on `Esc` without moving the focus, and never opens for a touch, which has no hover: on a phone, what a title says must be on the screen too.
- The label is the page's text color on the page color reversed: 4.5:1 in both themes, an outline in forced colors.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/tooltip.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/tooltip.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-fs-12`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bs-tooltip-auto` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-bottom` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-end` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-start` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-top` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `tooltip-arrow` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `tooltip-inner` | - | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `data-bs-toggle="tooltip"` | `data-tooltips` | review | keep the title: data-tooltips on <html> or a container shows every title inside as a tooltip; a toggletip for longer words |
| `data-bs-title` | `title` | rename | the element's own title, inside data-tooltips |
| `bootstrap.Tooltip` | - | remove | data-tooltips on <html> or a container shows the titles inside |

# Alerts

A message that stays on the page beside what it is about: a check passed, a suggestion, a warning before an action. A message that comes and goes is a [toast](toast.md).

## Examples

An icon, then the words in a `<div>`. The plain `alert` is neutral; the tones follow Bootstrap's.

```html
<div class="alert"><i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>The changes apply to the next booking.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-primary"><i class="bi bi-stars" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>A shorter title would fit the search results.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>White text on it: 5.6:1, AA in both themes.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-warning"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>The Thai translation is older than the English.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>The theme template raised a PHP warning; the page did not rebuild.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-info"><i class="bi bi-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>Translated by machine; a person has not read it yet.</div></div>
```

### With a title and actions

```html
<div class="alert alert-primary align-items-start" role="region" aria-label="AI suggestion">
	<i class="bi bi-stars" aria-hidden="true"></i>
	<div class="vstack gap-8">
		<strong>A shorter title</strong>
		<p>“Ang Thong by speedboat” fits the 60 characters search results show.</p>
		<div class="hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="button">Use it</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-text" type="button">Dismiss</button></div>
	</div>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- An alert that is on the page from the start is plain content - no live region. One that appears after an action and must be heard goes in a live region, or is a toast.
- A suggestion with its own actions is a `region` named after what it is.
- The icon carries the tone in forced colors; the words carry the meaning.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/alert.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/alert.css). It declares `--redz-alert-bg`, `--redz-alert-icon` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-info-subtle`, `--redz-info`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alert-dark` | - | review | the plain alert, or a tone |
| `alert-dismissible` | - | review | a btn-close at the end, removed by your script |
| `alert-heading` | - | review | a strong title in the alert's div |
| `alert-light` | - | review | the plain alert, or a tone |
| `alert-link` | - | review | a plain link |
| `alert-secondary` | - | review | the plain alert, or a tone |
| `data-bs-dismiss="alert"` | - | review | remove the alert in your script |

# Toasts

A notice after an action - saved, failed, moved with a way to undo - shown by `REDZ.ui.toast()` in a stack at the corner of the screen and read aloud from a live region.

## Examples

Success and info leave after 8 seconds, unless the pointer or the focus rests on them. An error, and a notice with an action, stay until closed.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-success">Saved</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-info">Import started</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-danger">Not saved</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-action">With an action</button>
```

The call takes the words and the tone and answers a function that closes the toast:

```js
const close = REDZ.ui.toast({title: 'Moved to the archive', tone: 'info', action: {label: 'Undo', run: restore}});
```

### The stack

The page carries the stack from the start, so that screen readers know its live regions before anything is said in them: `role="status"` for notices, `role="alert"` for errors. Without one, the library adds it at load.

```html
<div class="toast-container"><div role="status"></div><div role="alert"></div></div>
```

### How a toast looks

```html
<div class="toast toast-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Saved</strong><div class="text-muted fs-12">Ang Thong · 3 pages rebuilt</div></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-info"><i class="bi bi-info-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Import started</strong><div class="text-muted fs-12">You can leave this page.</div></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-warning"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Saved without the Thai text</strong></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Not saved</strong><div class="text-muted fs-12">The connection was lost; try again.</div></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
```
